bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/shos yin pa'i gong dkar gnam gru'i 'bab thang yang mdzes ljongs khul du gnas yod/ rtsed thang nas gong dkar bar gyi snum nag gzhung lam de yang mdzes ljongs khul gyi cha shas su khyab yod cing / mdzes ljongs khul gtso bo'i bgrod lam shar bgrod yin la/ mdzes ljongs kyi 'phrin gtong bde po yod pa ma zad/ mdzes ljongs sa khul nang logs kyi rdzong bdun la 'od skud 'phrin gtong shar bgrod thub pa dang sbrags rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi rang mthud kha par yang thogs med bde bgrod thub kyin yod/yar klung grags can mdzes ljongs khul gyi yun ring ba'i lo rgyus dang / 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas/grangs mang ba'i gna' shul/ brjid cing mdzes nyams ldan pa'i sa mtho'i rang byung mdzes ljongs bcas kyis rgyal khab phyi nang gi yul skor ba rnams phebs sgug zhu bzhin yod pas gnas 'dir spro gseng dang lta skor la phebs par dga' bsu sdon/gnas mchog tsa ri/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas chen tsa ri rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig yin 'ing /66

ba'i pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/rtsed thang nas lam thag le dbar2 0 5bskyod na chos zam du 'byor bas de ni tsa ri'i gnas mjal 'go tshugs sa yin pa dang / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid28 14yod/(gzhan de las mtho ba smos ci) de yang stod grags che ba gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti se/ bar du khungs btsun pa la phyi gangs ra/ smad ru 'gran zla bral ba lho gnas mchog tsa ri bcas bde mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas te/ gangs ti se sku yi gnas/ la phyi gsung gi gnas/ tsa ri thugs kyi gnas yin 'ing / de'ang tsa ri'i gnas la phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa ni/ tsa ri gsar ma tshe ring ljongs zhes pas gcig tsa ri mtsho dkar zhes pas gnyis/ dag pa shel ri zhes pa gsum bcas yod pa de dag gis rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum dang / phyi nang gsang gsum/ sku gsu/nga thugs gsum bcas mtshon yod la khyad par du tsa ri dkyil 'khor re/dag pa shel ri ni tsa ri'i gnas kyi gtso bo/ bde mchog gi sprul pa'i pho brang / byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba 'ig yin pas/ gnas 'di thog mar rgyal ba'i lung gis zin/ bar du chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas sogs kyi gzigs snang sna tshogs byung / de rjes mnyam med dwags po lha rjer tsa ri'i gnas kyi gzigs snang sna tshogs byang bas gnas sgo 'bye ba'i dus su babs pa mkhyen te rang (5dwar+sha

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/khong gi slob ma'i mchog gyur skyes bu ye shes rdo rjes thog mar gnas sgo phye/de nas rim bzhin 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po dang / 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras/ garma pa sku phreng bzhi pa/ kun mkhyen pad ma dkar po sogs skyes chen dam pa du mas gnas mchog tsa rir 'bas bcags nas gnas sgo gsar pa phye ba dang / dgon pa 'debs pa/ sgrub pa bskyon pa sogs bstan pa spel 'ing 'gro 'don ches cher bskyangs pas da lta'i gnas mchog tsa ri zhes pa'i gnas ngo mtshar can rgya che ba cha tshang bar grub/tsa ri'i gnas 'dir ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i thabs mchog rdo rje'i ri bo gdugs dang nya 'dra ba/ shes rab dril bu'i ri bo bum pa dang pad ma 'dra ba/ zung 'jug dbu ma'i ri bo dung dang pa ṭa 'dra ba/ mkha' spyod ngo mtshar ri bo rgyal mtshan dang 'khor lo 'dra ba sogs bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad kyi sa 'dzin mu khyud du bskor ba dang / de ba'in sgrol ma'i bla mtsho dang / 'od 'bar g.yu mtsho/ bde mchog bla mtsho/ pho brang g.yu mtsho sogs mtsho dang mtshe'u grangs las 'das pa yon chab kyi tshul du dwangs shing sngo thing nger 'khyil ba/ o rgyan phug dang / 'od 'bar mig ra phugaskyob chen phug byin rlabs phug sogs rang byung brag phug 68

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/gnas ri'i gzungs kyi dod du lhun gyis grub pa/ ga'an yang kurma pa sku phreng bzhi pas phyag btab pa'i mtsho dkar dgon pa dang / 'brug pa kun mkhyen pad ma dkar pos phyag btab pa'i cig car dgon pa/ da dung rang byung gi mchod rten dang skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi 'bas rjes dang phyag rjes sogs grangs kyis mi lang ba yod pa ma zad ri mo'i lam dang dmangs khrod du sa khyab rdo khyab kyis grags pa'i rtswa klu bdud rdo rje dang / chu 'gro ba 'dren pa gnyis kyi dri tsam tshor yang sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas thar pa'i lam sne zin pa 'di nyid gnas mchog tsa ri kho nar ma gtogs med par 'khums/de yang rtswa klu bdud rdo rje zhes rtswa rigs sna kha gcig kho na min par rtswa dang / me tog bsangs shing sogs tshang ma'i khrod du klu bdud rdo rje yod pas tsa ri'i bsangs sna ni ches rtsa che zhig tu brtsi ba dang / de bzhin chu 'gro ba 'dren pa'ang chu rgyud gangs sar 'dres yod pa dang / khyad par du mtsho dkar gyi mtsho gong 'og dang / o rgyan brag phug sbug gi mtsho/de bzhin cig car dgon pa dang nye ba'i dwangs bsil chu mig sogs la chu 'gro ba 'dren pa yod thag chod yin pa'i grags pas tshang mas de dag nas chu'i byin rlabs zhus te bod gangs can ljongs kyi sa cha ga sa gar 'khyer 'gro gi yod/ de lta bu'i gnas mchog tsa ri 'di nyid dus nges med du bskor chog 69

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/cing / khyad par du rta'i lo la gangs ti se bskor/ lug gi lo la mtsho gnam mtsho bskor/('khephye gangs bskor zhi sa kyang zer)sprel gyi lo la tsa ri gnas bzang bskor/ zhes spre lor tsa ri skor na phan yon shin tu che/ de'ang tsa rir rtse skor dang /bar skor/ rong skor zhes bskor ba che 'bring chung gsum yod kyang mig sngar rong skor ni mtha' mtshams yin pas thad sa med(thad mi chog)rtse skor dang bar skor la phebs pa'i dus tshod ni bod zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga nas bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga bar gnas sgo phye ba zhes dus tshod yag shos yin/mdor na tsa ri'i gnas la stabs bde'i ngang phebs 'dod mkhan nam yang na yul skor spro 'cham la phebs mkhan yin na rtsed thang nas rlangs 'khor chung ba'i nang snga tsam thon na dgong mo tsa ri lho mi khyim bdun nam tsa ri skyes dkar thang(da lta tsa ri shang gnas sa)du 'byor/ nyin gnyis par snga dro o rgyan brag phug mjal nas dgong dro cig car dgon du 'byor/ nyin gsum par snga dro cig car dgon dang chu mig sogs mjal ba dang / phyi dro phebs lam du gsang sngags chos gling dgon sogs mjal nas dgong mo lhun rtser 'byor/nyin ba'i par cung dal po'i ngang rtsed thang du slebs thub pa de ni rkang thang du bskyod pa'i dus tshod med pa'am 70

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/bskyod mi thub pa rnams la bltos nas bshad pa zhig yin/gal srid tsa ri'i gnas mjal cha tshang gnang 'dod na/nyin dang po rtsed thang nas rlangs 'khor chung ba'i nang snga tsam thon na dgong mo tsa ri shang du slebs pa gong dang 'dra ba dang /nyin gnyis par rkang thang du mtsho dkar phyogs su bskyod de nyin bzhi par tsa ri shang du log thub/ nyin lnga par snga dro o rgyan sgrub phug mjal nas dgong dro cig char dgon du slebs/nyin drug par cig char nas tsa ri dkyil 'khor ram dag pa shel ri'i phyogs su bskyod nas nyin bdun la dag pa shel ri 'khor gyi yod na'ang / bud med rnams tsa ri sgrol ma la nas 'gro mi chog pas cig char phyogs su rang 'jags log dgos/de ltar gnas mjal cha tshang la nyin1'unas15bar 'gor gyi yod pa de'ang rlangs 'khor 'gro sa yod sar rlangs 'khor nang bskyod pa'i dus tshod yin pas gal srid rtsed thang nas rkang thang mar tsa rir bskyod na zla gcig dang phyed ka nas zla gnyis bar 'gor zhes rgad po bskyod myong ba tshos gleng /de ltar tsa ri'i gnas ni lam thig ring 'ing / lam yang bde po med thog dpyid mgo nas ston mjug bar char pa'ang chad rgyu med pas gnas der bskyod par dka' tshegs che tsam yod rung tsa ri'i gnas skor la thengs gcig bskyod 71

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/thub kyang mi lus shig thob par gdon mi za zhes sngar nas da bar grags pas gnas mjal lam yul skor du bskyod mkhan ha cang mang po yod/sgrags yang rdzong /lho kha gra nang rdzong khongs sgrags shang gi lung phu'i nub ngos ri ldebs su gnas pa'i sgrags yang rdzong ni ches ngo mtshar che ba'i rang byung gi brag phug cig yin/ gnas 'di'i ming cha tshang la sgrags yang rdzong gshin rje rol ba'i pho brang zhes zhu zhing / slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs skyes chen du mas 'bas kyis bcags shing / yun ring sgrub pa gnang myong ba'i gnas 'di nyid ri glang chen 'gying ba'i rnam pa dang mtshungs pa'i ngogs na 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed ma he'i gdong can zhal lhor gzigs pa'i mkhur tshos g.yas su a dang / g.yon du hum gyi rang byon lha shing shug pas mtshon pa/ pad ma dra ba gling gi bkod pa dang mthun pa steng shod bar gsum mchis pa las/stod khang rig 'dzin phug g.yang gzar ngos bgrod skas gdang bu sum cu lhag tsam 'dzegs te ma he gdong can gyi shangs sbug nas o rgyan rin po ches kha ṭ+wāṃm rtse gsum gyis 72

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/gnas sgo 'bye gnang mdzad pa de nas zhugs pa na/ o rgyan chen po phyag dpung gi rjes dang / 'dre srin gyi gnod pa bzlog ched bzhag pa'i phyag sen gyi rjes/ sdig sgrib dag byed yi ge drug ma'i rang byon/ ma rig mun pa sel ba'i nyi zla rang byon/ mkha' 'gro mnyes nas me tog gi char babs pa'i rang byon/ srin po dom tshang du dam la btags pa'i phur pa rang byon/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gnas pa'i tsan dan dkar dmar gyi skas ka gdang bu nyer gcig pa/ grub thob me long rdo rjes gter nas bzhes pa'i gter khung / lo chen bai ro tsa na'i gzim phug mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi gzim phug nang shel gyi ka ba bzhi dang / mkha' 'gro bro rnga rang byon de bzhin ting shags dang / cang ti'u/ mda' mo/ rnga zlum sogs kyi rang byon/ yar thog gi ngos su dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i ma ṇi rang byon/ o rgyan chen pos lo gsum bzhugs pa'i gzim phug mkha' 'gro'i nu ma las babs pa'i tshe chu/ o rgyan chen po'i gsol zhib rang byon/ gzim phug gi nang rten gtso bya ma a krong las grub pa'i slob dpon gyi sku 'dra dang / rgya gar shar li las grub pa'i o rgyan byin can/ o rgyan chen pos sgrub pa mthar so na nas bdud dang dam srin btul ba'i don lnga snod drug gi rang byon/ phyi rol du mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gzhong / mkha' 'gro'i bro rar bal yul mchod rten rnam 73

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gsum gyi rang byon/ mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bro gar sna tshogs rtsed pa'i phyag —mdzub kyi rang byung sogs yod/drag sngags phug 'di ni gshin rje'i 'al nang du chags par grags shing / 'du khang gi nang rten gtso bo gter ston rat+na gling pa'i phyag bzo che mchog he ru ka mthing nag 'al gsum phyag drug g.yas g.yon du gu ru mtshan brgyad dang /rig 'dzin pad ma 'phrin las sogs bzhugs shing / da dung bod khams bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo/ byang gnam mtsho phyug mor gnas kyang / sgrub gnas 'di nyid kyi srung ma gnas bdag tu khas blangs pa'i lha mo rdo rje kun grags ma yi sku gsob sogs yod/zil gnon phug 'di ni da lta brag phug gi gnas sgo 'bye rgyu yin pas ser ga zhig mthong rgyu yod pa las gnas ngo ma re zhig mjal rgyu med kyang phyi nas mjal yang byin rlabs shin tu che/ de yang rdo brag rig 'dzin lnga pa skal bzang pad ma dbang phyug gis zil gnon phug gi gnas sgo 'byed pa'i tshe brag ri sgra chen po dang bcas rab tu 'gul zhing srubs ga'i nang khong gshegs par brtsams pa na gsol dpon gyis bla ma dam pa de na mi gshegs par 'tshal zhes zhus par rten 'brel 'phyug nas sgo ma bye bar ser ga slar yang sngar ltar zum pa dang bla ma'i mthang gos kyi sne mo zhig ser ga'i bar du lus 74

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/pas phyis su'ang mthang gos tshal pa re gnyis byung bar grags/da dung yang rdzong gnas sgo gsar pa zhes pa'i brag phug ngo mtshar can ga'an zhig yod pa de ni/ rdo brag rig 'dzin bzhi pa blo bzang pad ma 'phrin las kyis gnas g.ya' rig pad ma mtho lcog ces pa nas thang dkar rgod po zhig la sprul nas gnas sgo phye gnang mdzad cing / brag ngos rgod po'i gzugs dbyibs rang byon yod sa'i gnas sgo nas zhugs na g.yas phyogs su lcags kyi shal ma ri dang dung dkar g.yas 'khyil rang byon/ g.yon phyogs su bka' bstan 'gyur gyi kun dga' ra ba rang byon/ de nas rim bzhin song ba na/bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi rang byon dang / dgra bcom lnga brgya'i lhung bzed dang nyan thos chen po mchog brgyad kyi lhung bzed rang byon/ rig 'dzin pad ma 'phrin las kyi 'al dkar dang gter srung g.yu sgron ma'i mchod pa rang byon/ klu bdud nag pos dug sbrul du sprul nas gnod byed du 'ongs pas/ slob dpon chen pos mi 'jigs sprul pa'i rdo bsnun te dum bu gsum la gyur pa'i dug sbrul gyi khog stod bskal pa'i mar me mchod kong gi rang byon/ gza' bdud khyab 'jug gi rang byon/ shel gyi ka ba stag seng kha sprod kyi rang byon/dpagabasam shing gi 'bras bu rang byon/ dug sbrul sked par rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa'i rang byon/ mtsho 'gram du dug 75

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/sbrul gyi mjug ma'i rang byon/ de nas sngags srung e ka dza ti'i bla mtsho glang chen mche ba'i rnam pa can/ steng gi brag ngos su lha mo nyid kyi zhal 'bag la klu rgyal 'jog pos phul ba'i dar dkar rang byon sogs gnas mchog sgrags yang rdzong gi brag phug chen po gnyis kyi nang la ngo mtshar bsam yul las 'das pa'i rang byon gyis yongs su bkang ba dang /phyi la blta bas ngoms pa med pa'i rang byung mdzes ljongs kyis yongs su bskor nas yod do/ /rdzong sku 'bum/rdzong sku 'bum ni lho kha grwa nang rdzong sgrags shang gi shar ngos brag ri'i dbus su yod cing / brag phug khag nang sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi sku brnyan rang byon 'bum gcig yod pas brag phug de'i ming la'ang sku 'bum zhes zer/gnas 'di ni gu ru 'i ba pad+ma sam bha wa'i gsang gnas yin zhing / phyi ngos kyi brag ri'i dbyibs ni dung dkar kha sbubs pa dang shin tu 'dra/de yang rdzong sku 'bum du nang gses brag phug ba'i yod pa'i nang nas brag phug 'og ma shar brgyud brag phug dang /nub brgyud brag phug gnyis bzo dbyibs rang byung seng ge'i 76

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/kha nang du chags pa dang / brag phug gnyis po'i rang byung phyi sgo chen po gcig yin/ brag phug gong ma gnyis las bde chen gsang ba'i phug dma' sar yod pa dang / rdzong pad+ma rtse mtho sar yod/ma gzhi slob dpon pad+mas sa 'dir gnas sgo brgyad 'bye rtsis gnang yang rten 'brel ma grub pa'i dbang gis sgo mo dad log chu srin gyis bkag ste gnas sgo bzhi las phye ma thub pas steng shod gnyis kyi gnas bzhi la bstan pa'i gnas bzhi dang brag khog stong brdungs na rnga ltar grags pa zhig yod pa de la sbas pa'i gnas ba'i zer/brag phug 'o ma shar brgyud brag phug la sgo srung gsum yod pa ni( 1)rdo pha bong stag nyal ba 'dra ba dang /( 2)glang chen 'gying ba rang byon/( 2) mgon po bya rog gi rang byon bcas yin pa de dag ni slob dpon pad+mas ched du bsko bzhag mdzad pa zhig yin/brag phug 'di'i nang slob dpon pad ma'i gzim sbug byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba dang / mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs kyi mdzad shul mang po yod pa ma zad/ khyad par du ngo mtshar bsam yul las 'das pa'i rang byung ha cang mang po yod pa ni/ shar brgyud brag phug nang g.yas brag dkar po lha tshangs pa brgya byin gyi rang byon dang / g.yon 77

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/brag dmar po btsan gyi rang byon/ dbus slob dpon rin po ches gnas sgo phye dus dug sbrul tshar bcad pa'i rang byon/me tog pad ma zhal kha bye ba'i rang byon/ dung dkar rang byon/ mu tig dra ba'i rang byon/ mchod pa'i lha mo bco brgyad kyi rang byon/ oṃ a hūṃ gyi rang byon/ mar me rang byon/de ba'in slob dpon pad ma'i gzim phug dang / mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi gzim phug srin po pho mo'i tshang dus da lta'ang drod rta tsam yod ces grags pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi rang byon mang po yod/nub brgyud brag phug nang / dge 'dun tshogs ra tshugs sa'i chos sgra dang / rnga sgra/ dung sgra bcas nyan sa dang /slob dpon pad ma lha yul du phebs sa'i gsang lam/ mkha' 'gro'i chu skor gyi skad thos pa dang rtsam dri tshor sa/ de bzhin slob dpon pad mas srin po pho mo dam la btags nas gnam lcags phur pa bskyon sa'i rang byon dang / sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rang byon sogs rang byon mang po dang / khyad par du brag phug gi sbug tu dmag zor rgyal mo'i bla mtsho dang rnam sras kyi bla mtsho yod pa'i rtsa ba yar klung gtsang po dang 'brel bas gtsang po rba rlabs 'phyur dus kyi bye ma dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa dang / mtsho bdag ni ma bza' rdo gsum yin la skal ldan las 'phro can la mtsho mjal 'al gzigs yong gi 78

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/yod/bde chen gsang ba'i phug gi brag phug gi nang slob dpon pad mas 'i rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin bsregs mdzad pa dang / sbyin bsregs legs grub byung ba'i rten 'brel la mkha' 'gro pho mos gar 'khrab pa'i sgra snyan dang pi wang gi sgra skabs 'gar glo bur du grags pa dang / 'di na gnas mjal ba tshos kyang glu len gar 'khyab byed kyi yod/ de ba'in skabs 'gar gnas 'og ma'i mtsho gnyis 'khol ba'i rlangs pa'ang mjal rgyu yod pa dang / mkha' 'gros mchi med tshe yi sgrub pa bskyon sa dang / tshogs sha sna kha brgya dang brgyad klu yul nas gter du bzhes pa'i rus pa chung chung deng sus bsngogs kyang sa 'og nas don gyi yod/rdzong pad ma rtse'i brag phug ni mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi 'phyi ba sgom chen la sprul nas gnas sgo phye ba dang /gnas sgo 'di bar do 'grims sa yin zhes pas 'gro khag po yod/ brag phug 'di'i nang mkha' 'gro'i dbu skra rang byon dang / 'i khro'i lha tshogs zhi ba ba'i bcu zhe gnyis/ khrag 'thung lnga bcu nga brgyad kyi rang byon sogs rang byon mang po dang / zam pa dang rus sbal rang byon gyi 'og tu phyin pa tsam gyis sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa mi yong ba/ mthong grol mchod rten mjal ba tsam gyis ngan song las grol ba/ byang 79

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/chub mchod rten bya rung kha thor smon 'a ma btab tshad 'grub pa sogs gnas byin can mang po dang / da dung gnas 'di sbug thag shin tu ring la shar rgyag 'on khyi ra brag phug nang nas don thub pa'i shod srol ngo mtshar can yod pa dang /deng dus brag phug nang khyi dang ra gnyis kyi rang byon mjal rgyu yod/ mdor na rdzong sku 'bum gyi brag phug gi nang du ngo mtshar gyi rang byon grangs las 'das pa dang rtsa che'i gzim sbug sogs shin tu mang ba dang / phyi la ri bo lhun grub rtse dang pad ma rtse la sogs pa sngo ljang nags kyis yongs su/ brgyan pa dang / ri dwags dang gcan gzan sna tshogs ci gar rgyu zhing /'dab chags sna brgyas snyan pa'i gre 'gyur glu dbyangs len pa/brag phug gi sgo 'gram nas dwangs gtsang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun shang shang du babs pa sogs skye bo kun gyi yid brtan dbang med 'phrog pa dang / yid ngal gso ba'i yul skor mdzes ljongs khyad par can zhig yin no/ /mon yul gyi mdzes ljongs/mtsho sna rdzong khongs su yod pa'i mon yul ni rman pa mi rigs bca' sdod byed sa'i mtha' mtshams kyi mdzes ljongs shig yin zhing / rtsed thang nas lam thag le dbar2 2 2yod 80

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/pa dang / cha snyoms rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid2 40 0tsam yin/mon yul ni sa bab dma' la char chu 'dzoms pa/ thon khungs phun sum tshogs shing / ri klung nags tshal dang rtswa ljang me tog gis khengs pa'i mdzes ljongs lta na sdug pa zhig yin pas yul skor spro 'cham gnang yul khyad par can zhig yin/ rags par bshad na mon gyi yul de shar nub gnyis su phye ba dang / de yang rta dbang gi nub ngos skyems stong la rtse ni shar nub 'byed mtshams yin pa de nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud dwags po dang / spang chen/ legs po bcas yod pa de rnams la mon nub ma zer ba dang / shar rgyud du nyi mtsho gsum dang / hro dang byang dwags/ seng ge rdzong dang /gnyug ma gdong sbrang ma chu rgyud/ rong nang bcas yod pa de rnams la mon shar ma zer/ mon yul gyi sa dbyibs zheng tshad chung 'ing ring tshad ches ring ba'i thog byang nas lhor rgyug pa'i nya bshang chu dang / shar nas nub tu rgyug pa'i sbrang ma chu'am rta dbang chu/ nub nas shar lhor rgyug pa'i sbrang nang chu/ byang nas lhor rgyug pa'i rong nang chu bcas yod la nam dus ba'i gar dbye ba chen po med par gnam gshis dro zhing /thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod/ ngo mtshar yid dbang 'phrog pa dang thun min gyi khyad chos 'bum gyis phyug pa'i mon 81

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/yul 'di ba'in gna' snga mo nas krung go'i bod ljo ngas kyi mnga' khongs bsnyon du med pa cig dang kha bral du rtsa ba nas/ mi rung ba'i cha shas mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin par brten srong btsan sgam pos bod kyi sa bkra srin mo gan rkyal gyi nang du mon yul bkod yod la mon yul du mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang yang bzhengs yod cing / lhag par du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i dus nas bzung bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mon yul yongs su srid 'dzin sgrig ga'i dngos su btsugs thog srid 'dzin do dam nus pa thon pa byas ngang byed bzhin pa yin la da lta legs po khul la mi rigs shang bzhi dang / don gcod khang gcig yod pa'i sa khongs me tog gi skyed tshal ltar rab tu mdzes pa ma zad lo rgyus dang shod srol ngo mtshar ldan pa'i srin mo brag sogs dgon pa dang / rang byung brag phug dang mtsho dang rgyug chu sogs shin tu mang ba ma zad legs po don gcod khang dang slad shang bar gyi grog shur nang gi brag ngos su rgya nag gi grags can rtsom rig〈nub phyogs su gnas skor bskyod pa'i〉nang gi mi sna gtso bo/ thang sen bla ma dang /spre'u/ phag pa/ hā shang / rta bcas kyi brag brkos ri mo zhig yod pa de ni ha lam bod yongs su med pa'i rdo brkos sgyu rtsal 'ig yin pa ma zad ri mo de'i 'grel bshad la/ thang sen bla ma 'phags yul nas chos blangs te bod yul brgyud nas phyir 82

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/log gnang ba'i shod srol zhig kyang yod pas der 'ib 'jug gi rin thang ha cang chen po yod pa sogs mon yul gyi legs po mi rigs shang bzhi dang / legs po don gcod khang khor yug gi mdzes ljongs ni ri mor bris pa ltar mdzes shing yid du 'ong la ngo mtshar che ba'i lo rgyus dang shod srol khyad chos ldan pa'i yul skor spro 'cham gnang yul thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin no/ /gnas chen mkha' regaganas chen mkha' reg gtsang rin spungs rdzong khongs bar thang shang gi shar ngos/ lho kha sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs mkha' reg yul gru'i nub ngos su yod/ gnas 'di ni slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis yun ring sgrub pa gnang zhing /sa gzhi gang sar byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas ma chog khyad par can 'ig yin/'di ni slob dpon pad ma'i sgrub phug dang / zhabs rjes/ mtsho sbug ces ri bo'i steng du yod pa'i ngo mtshar gyi mtsho/ mtshan rtags zhes pa'i ri bo'i steng du se ba'i sdong po la me tog dmar po shar gyi yod pa de rje btsun sgrol ma'i zla mtshan gyi rtags yin zhes grags pa/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 83

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod khang zhes ya ngas shing rgya che ba'i brag phug de bzhin gna' bo'i dgon rnying sgrub bde dang / nu na dkar mchod rten la sogs pa gnas ngo mtshar can ha cang mang po mjal rgyu yod/khyad par yongs su grags pa'i mkha' reg jo pho jo mo zhes par chos lugs thad gnas 'di mjal na ngan song gi gnas las grol ba dang / sdig sgrib dag pa sogs 'grel bshad shin tu mang ba ma zad/ dmangs khrod ngag rgyun gyi srol yang mang po yod/ de'ang mkha' reg ri bo'i rtse mo'i gtso bo'i ri rtse khag gnyis su gyes yod pa'i jo pho ri bor bde mchog yab kyi pho brang dang / jo mo ri bor bde mchog yum gyi pho brang zhes shod srol mchis/ de yang dmangs khrod ngag rgyun du/ sngar jo pho dang jo mos 'jig rten bza' 'tsho'i 'tsho ba skyel skabs lo gcig gi dgun khar jo mo'i ri rtser kha ba cung zad che ba babs te mgo 'phang mtho tsam chags pas jo phos mig gzer brgyab nas jo mo khyed sngon chad bdag la brtse ba che bas mig gnyis nyin ltar bdag la 'phangs pa las skad cig tsam yang gzhan du g.yo ba ma mchis kyang da lta khyed ske krong krong byas nas ga par blta gi yod dam/ gtan gtan gnod sbyin gangs ba bzang mor sems shor ba thag chod ces jo mor gram lcag me 'bar ba zhig gzhus/ jo mo jo pho'i ma nyes kha g.yog dang nyes rdung la rab tu khros te jo phor blta mi 'dod par 84

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/rgyab phyogs te bar thang yul la bltas/ bar thang gi bu rnams byad bzhin mdzes po yod pa ni jo mo'i zhal gyi byin rlabs yin zer/ jo pho sngar bzhin reg yul la zhal phyogs pas mkha' reg gi pho gzhon tsho dpa' nyams ldan la mi spus dag ces grags/da dung jo pho jo mo byang du brag ri mthon po rtse mo rab tu rno ba thig steng brag sho don pa(brag kha sho)ni mda' mo'i ltong ka dang shin tu 'dra ba zhig yod pa de ltar chags don ni/gna' snga mo gling ge sar rgyal pos bdud rgyal khyung chen gang thar 'ded pa dang / bdud rgyal khyung chen g.yas bros g.yon bros mang du byas mthar ri bo de'i steng babs pas ge sar gyi mda' mo 'ig drag tu 'phangs ma thag brag ri de kha sho chags pa red ces zer ba la sogs pa'i thod rgyun mang du yod pas/gnas mchog mkha' reg ni gcig nas chos lugs kyi gdan sa rtsa chen dang gnyis nas dmangs bro/ da shod srol gyi deb ther chen po zhig dang 'dra ba'o/ /mtsho rgyal bla mtsho/rtsed thang nas spyi le42bskyod na gra nang mda'i yang kha gru khar slebs shing / de nas glog gru'i nang chu tshod gnyis 85

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/tsam bskyod na chu phar phyogs kyi sgrags gru sar 'byor/ de na 'khor lam brgyud spyi le lnga dang phyed ka bskyod na mtsho rgyal grong tsho'i dbus su yod pa'i mtsho rgyal bla mtsho mjal thub/mtho tshad ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid 26 0 0tsam yod/de yang mtsho rgyal bla mtsho zhes pa ni thog mar gnas der chu mig cig yod cing / spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad par grong tsho de na mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgya' 'khrungs pa dang dus mtshungs chu mig de mtsho ltar rgyas skabs ma/tsho rgyal bla mtsho 'es pa'i mtshan de ltar byung / mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi 'khrungs khang yang de dang nye bar yod/mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal yum gza' dge bya ba'i lhums su bzhugs skabs yum la gser gyi bung ba gsung skad snyan pa zhig yab kyi spyi bor thims pa'i gzigs snang byung ba dang / yab mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gi gzigs snang la yum la spyan gsum mnga' ba sogs snga ltas khyad par can mang du byung ba dang bya lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs a li ka li'i rang sgra rang byung lhun gyis gsal bar sgrog bzhin du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang /'brug ldir ba/ me tog gi char pa babs pa sogs kun gyis mthong / yab de'ang skyes bu dam pa'i rang gshis tshang ba zhig yin pas brtag pa mdzad mthar rab tu mnyes te nga 86

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/gnyis kyi bu mo/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags du ma dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pas nar son rjes grags pa 'dzam gling la khyab cing / nyam thag 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon zhig tu 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ bu mo skyes pa dang nged tsho'i chu de yang mtsho ru rgyas 'dug pas bu mo'i ming la'ang yang yes shes mtsho rgyal zhes 'dogs dgos gsungs/de nas bu mo nar son rjes rab tu mtshar 'ing byams sems ldan pas slong mi dpon chen mang du byung ba phan tshun 'khrug rtsod kyi nyen kha chen po byung ste yab yum bya dka' byed gtad du gyur pa'i tshe chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi snyan pa mkhyen te btsun mor bsus /de nas mi ring bar chos rgya' gyis slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs pa dang / btsun mo ye shes mtsho rgyal slob dpon la phul bas slob dpon gyi jo mor mnga' gsol/ de nas slob dpon yab yum gnyis mchims phur byon nas slob dpon gyi drung nas rab tu byung ste sde snod gsum gyi chos mtha' yas pa gas na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i 'al gzigs/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob/ mngon par shes pa mnga' brnyes shing rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med par ston nus par 'gyur pas kun gyis rab tu dad de mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhes grags/ mtsho rgyal bla mtsho'i 'gram gyi mtsho 87

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/rgyal lha khang nang mtsho rgyal gyi sku 'dra dang / mtsho rgyal 'khrungs rjes lte khrag 'pho sar tsan dan dkar dmar gnyis 'khrungs pa las 'o ma bzhes pa'i tsan dan dum bu sogs rtsa chen khag mjal rgyu yod/ rtswa thang dkar mo gling /bod sa khul yongs su skad grags yod pa'i rtswa thang dkar mo gling ni lho kha sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i nye 'gram du yod cing / mtsho mo'i khor yug tu chags pa'i ri rnams bzo bo mkhas pas ched du bcos pa lta bu'i ri dpyad legs shing / sa mtho'i khyad ldan gyi rtsi shing spa ma rum 'thag mkhas pas sa gdan ched du btags pa ba'in ring thung spu tsam med par mgo gra snyoms pa'i rang byung lhun gyis 'grub pa'i mdzes chos lta bas mi ngoms pas brgyan pa'i ri chung gnyis yod pa gcig gi ming la sdig nag zer ba dang /cig shos de'i ming 'a/ sde rgya ze ba zer ba'i ri gsham du dwangs shing gtsang ba'i chu mig cig yod pa de'i lho ngos dkar gling gzhung chu zhes pa'i chu mdog gzhan dang mi 'dra ba chu mo zhig lhung lhung rgyu ba'i nang sna rigs mi gcig pa'i nya mo mang po yar rgyugs mar rgyags byed pa'i ngo mtshar ltad mo skye bo'i mig 88 ༄

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/lam du 'char ba dang / chu 'gram du bsangs shing 'khan dkar mi tshad lon pa mthug por skye ba'i khrod sems can spu nag g.yag rgan yang gzhan gyis mthong bar dka' ba de lta bu ni bod yongs su ha lam med ces bshad chogagazhan yang rtswa thang de ni sa rgya yangs shing khod snyoms la rtswa bcud rab tu che ba ma zad rtswa'i skye kha bzang ba ha las dgos pa zhig yod pa ste/ dgong mo rtswa thang steng ja phor kha sbubs slog nas ba'ag na zhogs pa ja phor rtswa yis bkyag nas gan rgyal log nas sdod kyi yod pas rtswa thang skye kha bzang ba de 'dra bod ljongs yongs su med stabs sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung rta ched du rtswa thang de'i steng 'jog gi yod pa las/ sems can gzhan dag phar bzhag bya dang byi'u'ang babs mi chog ces pa'i bka' rgya nan po btang yod/da dung rtswa thang de'i mdzes sdug rnam par bkra ba'i me tog sna tshogs dang / bya byi'u sna tshogs/ ri dwags dang gcan gzan sna tshogs sogs yod pas rtswa thang de ni ma bcos rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i yul skor mdzes ljongs ches phul du byung ba zhig yin no/ /89

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/ngo mtshar yid du 'ong ba'i gri gu rtswa thang /bod mi'i 'byung gnas su grags pa'i rtsed thang grong rdal nas lhung lhung 'bab pa'i dwangs gtsang sham chu brgyud lho phyogs su chas tshe srid pa'i la dgu'i ya gyal gangs ri chen po yar lha sham po'i nye 'dabs su 'byor 'ing / de nas nub phyogs su kha gtad de phyin na mtsho smad rdzong gi mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i 'khar zhes pa'i grong tshor slebs/ grong cho de'i phur bye la zhes pa'i la 'ig yod cing / dmangs khrod kyi shod rgyun du/ sngon la mo de nyid ha cang mtho bas yul de'i mi rnams la mo de barbal nas yul gzhan du 'gro 'ong byed tshad dka' tshegs shin tu che ba'i gnas tshul de rgya bza' kong jos mkhyen rjes ri bo der gseng kha ( phug lam) gtod dgongs kyang phyis su rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi rkyen pas gse nga kha gtod rgyu ma byung bar grags shing la de'i rtse mor slebs tshe/ da gzod gri gu rtswa thang de nyid mig lam du khra lam mer mngon thub/rgyang ring nas bltas tshe/ gri gu rtswa thang de nyid mi rab dkar dar gyi thor lcog bcings shing sngo ljang na bza' kun nas bklubs pa'i yid du 'ong ba'i lha yi bu mo/ 'ig gis/ 90

ba'i pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/dwangs shing gas la ba'i me tog cig phyag tu bsnams nas mi yul du ltad mor phebs pa dang gnyis su med/ rtswa thang de'i phyogs ba'i na shel gyi ma chod rten bzhengs 'dra'i gangs ri dkar po dang / rtse mo gnam la zug 'dra'i rdza ri smug po/ga 'u/ yi ma/ṇ+ḍal spungs 'dra'i spang ri sngon po sogs tshar du dngar ba'i ri tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / de dag gi bar bar na/ dwangs bsil brgyad lda na gtsang chab kyis bkang ba'i mtshe'u du ma sngo lhem mer 'khyil/ rtswa thang de'i steng na lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i chu phran dwangs mo'i 'gram gyi sngo ljang ne'u gsing thog dkar ser dmar sngo'i me tog khra chil ler ba'ad cing bung ba gachon nus dar dir gyi gshog glu snyan mo len pa dang phye leb bu mos lhab lheb kyi bro gar ma/tshar po 'khrab nas skye bo rnams kyi yid kyi brtan pa cig car 'phrog par byed kyin yo/da/ skar tshogs sa la babs 'dra'i g.yang dkar gyi khyu tshogs dang/ bre se ra 'brong sto bas la 'khu ba'i 'bri g.yag gi khyu tshogs ni rtswa thang gi rgyan cha dang 'brog pa'i 'tsho brten 'a gas shing / da dung rgyal khab kyi rim pa dang po'i sru/nga skyob kyi sro ga chags su gtogs pa'i kha dkar rkyang gi khyu tshogs dang / ga'an ya nga gna' ba ngang / gnyan/ dgo ba so gas kyi ri skyes sro ga chags rnam/sa ci 'dod rtswa chur rol byung bag phebs/ dal gyi rgyu ba ni rang byung kham sa chen po bde 9/

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/ba'i chang gis myos pa min na ci 'ig yin/ yang sgos su dang ra g.yu mtsho de nyid ni gri gu'i rtswa thang 'di ko yu la ga'an las khyad du 'phags pa'i mtshon rtags su 'khums shing / g.yu mtsho'i gting na lto dkar nya mo'i tshogs kyis 'khyug 'khyug gar la rol cing / g.yu mtsho'i kha nang ngang pa dang / ngur pa/khrung khrung sogs chu bya sna tshogs kyis mgrin pa'i rdza rnga bar med du 'khrol ba ni snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i mnyam sgrog rol dbyangs shig dkrol ba dang kun nas mtshungs/ sngo ljang rtswa thang de'i bar bar na 'brog pa'i sbra gur chom bu tshom bur phub pa de dag gi nang du dkar po 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil 'ing /ser po mar gyi rtsig pa brtsigs pa dang / nag po spu yi sprin nag g.yo zhing dkar po bal gyi sprin dkar lang long du 'phyur/da dung gri gu'i 'brog dmangs gtan sdod bya yul gyi shar lho'i mtshams na ri chung zhig yod pa de'i steng gi byang shar na mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi nor bu yid ba'in du 'jo ba'i jo bo bsam 'phel nor bu bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang de nyid brjid chags ger 'gying 'ing / ri chu'i de'i steng gi nub byang ngos ni mdo mkhar 'bas drung tshe ring dbang rgyal mchog gis bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog brtsams sgrung ring gras ang dang po yin pa'i grags rtsom〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉dbu rtsom sa'i byin che'i gnas mchog lcags 92

ba'i pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/rtse gri gu'i rdzong shul yin/gri gu grong tsho'e byang ngos nas lhog lhog tu 'khol ba'i rang byung chu tshan zhig yod cing / mi tshos chu tshan der khrus la zhugs na grum bu sogs kyi nad bcos thub par grags/ga'an yang / 'o re'i spyi zla dgu pa'i zla stod du yul de'i 'brog pa rnams kyis nyin gsum nas lnga bar dbyar skyid gtong zhing / dbyar skyid de ni yul der mtshon na lo re'i bod kyi lo gsar phud pa'i dus chen rgyas shos shig yin/de'i tshe de'i dus na 'brog pa rnams kyis lus la gzab mchor gyis spud de rta rgyugs dang / sbag sbag dang rkang 'khor mgyogs los/ thag pa 'then pa/ sgor gzhas rgyag rgyu/ bye ba 'gyogs pa sogs kyi 'gran bsdur byed cing / pho gzhon rnams la mtshon na dus de ni rang gi dpa' rtsal ngom pa'i dus skabs legs shos shig dang / mo gzhon rnams la mtshon na dus de ni rang gi lang tsho'i dpal yon dang snyan 'jebs mgren glu ngoms pa'i dus skabs legs shos shig yin/ de'i tshe sku nyid gri gur phebs na sbag btsog gi g.ya' dang bral ba'i zas rigs te/ shar mar thud gsum dang / zho dang /'o ma/ mar zan sogs ci 'dod longs su spyod rgyu yod cing /de'i tshe de'i dus na sku nyid kyis da gzod rang byung khams chen po'i bde ba longs su spyad chog la/ ngo mtshar yid du 93

bod ljo ngas lho kha'i yul smor gnas ljo ngas ngo sprong —'ong ba'i rtswa thang gi ma/dzes ljongs 'a 'dren byed dbang pos ci 'dod tshim par rol chog pa ma zad/ 'brog pa'i snga ra gyi yul srol dang deng gi dar srol gnyis gar longs su spyad chogalcags zam chu bo ri dang che chu sgrub sde/lcags zam chu bo ri mi bod kyi ri chen ba'i'i ya gyal zhig yin byung / de yang ri chen ba'i zhes pa ri gnas ri rtsa chen yin pa las ri che shos sa ma mtho shos la zer ba min/ de yang zer srol la ri 'di'i ngogs dang ldebs la dgon pa brgya dang brgyad/ dur khrod brgya dang brgyad/ chu mig brgya dang brgyad bcas yod par grags shing / deng sa nga chu bo ri'i byang ngos lha chu zhis pa'i chu mi ga gi chus khrus byas na nad rigs kun 'joms zhis snyan grags che bas phyogs kun nas skye bo bung ba pad mtshor 'khor ba ba'in shin tu mang po slebs kyi yo da/tshe chu sgrub sde dgon ni sngon slob dpon pad mas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan la tshe sgrub gnang skabs thog kha nas tshe bum pho rog gcig gis khur nas sa/ der sbas pas phyis de nas babs pa'i chu btungs na tshe 'phel bas dgon rmi nga la'ang tshe chu sgrub sde ches thogs/ thog ma/ra dgon pa 'di 94

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/smin grol gling gi khongs yin pas der bzhugs dge 'dun brgyad grwa gcig gi 'tsho gos smin grol gling nas 'gan len zhu gi yo/da kyang / phyis lams kyi bla ma tshe dbang bsam grub dang /blo bzang bsam grub ces pa gnyis ri ldebs kyi bsam gtan gling du bzhugs pa dgon de'i bla mar gdan drangs pas rim ba'in chos lugs dge lugs par 'gyur/de rjes ra sgreng rgyal thog skabs 'du khang gsar bzhengs gnang / dgon pa'i g.yas ngos su chu bo ri'i gnas sgo yod par/ sngon ra rdzi zhig gi ra dkar po gcig rtag par mthong sar sdod kyi med pas nyin 'ig ra rdzis ra'i mjug tu phyin pas yul skyid po pad ma bkod ces bya ba lha yul dang 'dra ba'i skyid po 'ig la slebs pas ra rdzi'i sems la rang gi pha ma gnyis kyang 'dir bsu dgos snyam nas khyim du pha ma 'bod par phyin te kho tsho mnyam du sa der slebs dus gnas sgo zum zin pa dang / de nas bzung chu bo ri'i gnas sgo sus kyang phye ma thub par gyur ces zer/ga'an yang chu bo rir ming 'bod tshul kha shas yod kyang ri 'di'i 'gram gyi yar klung gtsang por grub chen thang stong rgyal pos lcags zam bskrun pa nas bzung ri bo'i ming la ñtsa gas zan / chu bo ri 'es brjod nga rbi yongs su grags pa 'ig yin no/95

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gangs ri yar lha sham po/ bod yongs su rlung ltar grags pa'i gangs ri ya ra lha sham po ni/ yar mo klung gi phu la gnas yod cing / rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le5 2yod pa dang / mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas spyi khre60 0 0tsam yod/gangs ri 'di ni bod mi dmangs kyi gus bkur zhu sa'i srid pa'i lha dgu'i gras shig yin pa ma zad/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / khri srong lde btsan sogs kyis bsten pa'i srung ma rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum zhes pa'i gras shig kyang yin/ gangs ri'i bzo dbyibs ni thog mar mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang dang 'dra ba 'ig yod kyang sa mtho'i nyi 'od kyis rim bzhin bzhur bas bzo lta 'gyur zhing cung tsam dma' ru song yod thog ri sked kyi dbyibs la mtho zhing gzar ba dang / la la skas rim ltar chags pa sogs ngo mtshar ldan pa zhig yod pa de'i mdun phyogs nas chu bo yar lha sham chu shang shang du 'bab kyi yod/ chu 'gram g.yas g.yon gyi yar klung zhing thang ni gser gyi ga'ong pa dang 'dra ba'i 'bru rigs kyi bang mdzod cig yin pas yar klung la bod kyi 'bru mdzod 96

bzhi pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/ces pa'i mtshan snyan thob yod pa dang / sngo ljang lcang ma'i rigs dang / khra chil me tog gi rigs ni yar klung lcang gseb gling kha zhes lha yul gyi skyed tshal dang gnyis su med pa lta bur snang / da dung gangs ri 'di'i rgyab phyogs kyi chu ni e chu mdo gyang lung shur du 'bab kyi yod pas de'i rgyud du rtswa chu phun sum tshogs pa phyugs rigs dkar nag spro skyid gtong sa'i mdzes ljongs chen po zhig lhun gyis grub yod/yang gangs ri 'dir sngon lo rgyus thog ngo mtshar can gyi lha sgrung yang mang po shod rgyu yod pa dper na/ bod rgyal brgyad pa gri gum btsan po blon po lo ngam gyis bkrongs rjes rgyal po'i btsun mo gangs ri yar lha sham po dang nye sar bros phebs pa'i mtshan mo zhig('ga' zhig gi rta 'tsho bar phebs zhes kyang zer) yang lha sham po'i sprul pa lha g.yag dkar po zhig dang 'grogs pa rmis pas sku lus sbrum mar gyur ba dang /zla dgu ngo bcu song rjes khye'u zhig btsas pa'i ming la ru las skyes zhes btags/ khye'u de cher longs nas dgra sha blangs pa dang / rgyal srid skyong rogs byed mkhan gyi blon po mchog tu gyur pa mdzangs mi bdun gyi dang po ru las skyes zhes bod yongs la grags pa sogs shod rgyun shin tu mang /gzhan yang sngar nas da bar yar klung gi rgya che'i chos dad pa ser skya mang tshogs tshos yul yar klung la bsdad na lha 97

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/yar lha sham po gsol dgos ches gangs ri yar lha sham po 'di nyid mchog tu gyur pa'i yul lha 'ig tu brtsis nas dang gus tshad med zhus te yar lha sham po dgyes na rang nyid tshe ring nad med dang / bya ba lam 'gro yong ba dang / yar lha sham po khros na gegs dbang bar chad yong ba'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yo da pa ma zad bod yu la gyi sa cha ga'an dag nas kyang ched mngags yar lha sham po mjal bar phebs ma khan mang po yo/da pa dang / da dung gangs bskor thengs lnga dang / bcu/su ma cu sogs rgyag mkhan yang mang po yod/zangs ri 'ol kha chu tshan/rtsed thang nas byang shar zangs ri rdzong khongs la lam thag spyi le72phyin na 'ol kha chu tshan zhes yongs su grags pa der slebs shing / deng rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid4 2 0 0tsam yo da/'o' kha'i chu tshan la khag mi 'dra ba lnga yod pa ni/ sman chu chu tshan dang/ 'phags pa chu tshan/ spang kha chu tshan/skyogs gcus cu tshan/ gro lo kha'i chu tshan bcas yin 'ing /de dag las grags che shos gro lo kha'i chu tshan ni na thang rkya zhing mdzes pa 'ig gi dbus su gnas yod pa dang / na thang 98

ba'i pa/ rang byung yid 'phrog ri chu/'dres mtshams kyi rdo hrug bar nas chu me btang nas bskol ba ltar lhog lhog tu 'khol ba'in yod/ chu tshan de mi lo rgyus thog tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim/ byon gyi khrus gsol chu rdzing yin pas sngar skye bo ga'an sus kyang der chu tshan brgyab chog gi med/chu tshan 'di'i khyad chos ni na tsha khyon yongs la phan pa las gang la'ang mi gnod cing / thengs mang po brgyab na de bas phan pa dang / thengs gcig las ma brgyab kyang chu lan slog pa zhes nges par du thengs gnyis pa rgyag par 'gro dgos kyi med/chu tshan gyi rgya khyon ni spyi le gru ba'i ma nyi shu ma zim tsam gyi dkyil du sngar gyi rdo ring gru ba'i ma ring tshad skar ma bzhi bcu yod pa 'gying nger btsugs yod pa dang / chu'i gting tshad spyi khre gnyis ma zin tsam yod la bshal chu phyir 'gro sogs/ gtsang 'ing khams dwangs pa 'ig yod/ ga'an yang chu tshan 'di'i gnas yul ngo mtshar yid du 'ong ba'i ne'u gseng spang gathongs yangs shing rgya che'i lho phyogs su srid pa'i gangs ri mtho po 'o de gung rgyal dang / byang du chos lung dgon gyi rgyab ri rtse mo rdza ri dang / bar du nags ri/ ri gsham spang ri bcas byed pos ched du bskrun pa lta bu/ nub tu rdzing phyi'i phu cha dwangs shing gtsang ba lhu nga lhu nga rba ba/ shar phyogs ma khyad ༄༄mi rbangamo ra/bye9)zu

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/kyi ri bo maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu lta bus mdzes par bskor yod/de bzhin chu tshan ga'an ba'i por yang rang rang gi khyad chos re yod pa ste/ sman chu chu tshan gyis gtso bo ya mar shin tu phan pa dang / 'phags pa chu tshan gyis gtso bo 'bam grum dang pags nad la phan pa/ spang kha chu tshan gyis gtso bo chu ser dang grang nad la phan pa/ skyogs gcus chu tshan gyis gtso bo pho smug dang tshad rnying la phan pa sogs khyad chos gtso bo'i dbang gis bshad pa las phan yon gzhan shig tu mang /ga'an yang 'ol kha ni yul ljongs mdzes shing skyid la/thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa/ khyad par du 'ol khar chu rigs gsum mgon po rang byung lhun grub kyis zhal 'dzoms byung yod pa ste/ shar phyogs 'o de gung rgyal gangs ri las 'bab pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi chu bo dkar po 'o ma'i mdog dang / byang phyogs rdzing phyi'i lung chu ngo mtshar spang ri las 'bab pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi chu bor ser skya gur gum mdog nub phyogs sle lung phu chu brjid chags rdza ri las 'bab pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i chu bo sngo nag mchin pa'i mdog sogs ngo mtshar gtam rgyud snyan pos mi sems yid dbang cig car 'gug pa'i rang byung mdzes ljongs mang po yod do/ /100

lnga pa/ khrud 'phags bzo skrun dig dngos gzigs 'dod na/ sku nyid sgyu rtsal zhing khams lho khad phebs/s+ho brag sras mkhar dgu thogalho brag sras mkhar dgu thog ni lho kha sa khul lho brag rdzong khongs su gnas shing / rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le28 2yod pa dang / mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid40 0rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pas1077lo nas108 4lo'i bar du phyag btab/ de'ang rje btsun mi la ras pa ni chos lugs grub mtha' ris med kyi dad mos dang brtsi bkur zhu sa'i grags can gyi chos pa rnam dag cig yin zhing / gtsang smyon he ru gas brtsams pa'i khongagi lo rgyus〈rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar〉ni rgyal phyi rgyal nang gang sar skad grags yod/lho brag sras mkhar dgu thog ni rje btsun mi la ras pas khong gi bla ma mar pa lo tsā ba'i bka' bzhin tshe stod bsags 101

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod /pa'i sdig pa dag pa'i ched du mi gcig lag gcig gis bzhengs pa zhig yin pas khong gis snying rus la ha mi las pa dang / dad gus mi byed mkhan su'ang med/de rjes lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang 'ig gso dang rgya bskyed byas pa brgyud dbu rtse'i gser skyibs thog rim dgu dang ldan pa'i btsan mkhar gzugs can gyi gtsang khang gru ba'i ma bkod pa'i gtso bor ba'ag pa'i bod lugs kyi dbyibs bzo thun mong ma yin pa'i dgon pa 'ig tu gyur/dgon pa 'di ni bka' brgyud bstan pa'i 'byung khungs kyi chu 'go cig yin pas byin rlabs dang snyan grags gnyis ka che/dgon pa'i rten gtso byang chub chen po ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i sku 'dra sku tshad bcu drug pas gtsos rin thang bral ba'i sku gsung thugs rten bgrang gis mi lang pa da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ shin tu dkon pa'i dpe rnying bris ma de dag ni dgon pa de rang gi btab lo dang mnyam pa'am yang na de las lo sum brgya bzhi brgyas snga ba'i lo rgyus yod pas rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos gtsigs cher 'dzin dang 'dzin ba'in pa yin/ga'an yang gdan sa 'di'i yang dben gnas stag nye zhes par rje btsun mi lar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang 102

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun ri ga dngos/bskur zhing / gdams ngag rdzogs par rngakanang zhing / mi la ras pas bla ma'i bka' ba'in zla ba bcu gcig ring mar me mgo thog tu ba'ag pas tshe gcig lus ba/cig la sangs rgyas pa'i lo rgyus yod pa dang / mar pas deng sang4 bod du brgyud pa chad pa'i pho ba grong 'jug ces pa ste/ mi dang sems can sogs shi ba'i ro la rang gi rnam shes zhu/sa/sa te slar gson par byed pa'i gdams ngag khyad par ca( 5/ de'ang gnas 'di na mdzad/ des na gnas 'dir sleb7sa tsam gyis rig pa dwangs/ dge sbyor 'phel/ der bzhu gas bsam gtan pa rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams shertogs khyad par can 'khrungs pa sogs yon tan mtha' yas dang ldan no/ /o rgyan smin gro' / rdospeng /smin grol gling dgon pa ne lho kha gra nang rdzong gra phyi shang khongs su gnas shing / dgon pa 'a de ni dbus kyi rnying ma'i dgon pa gtso gras shig yin pas nga ga rgyun du dbus na rdor smin dpal gsum zhes dbus kyi rnying dgon gtso bo rdo rje brag dang / smin grol gling/ 'phyongangs rgyas dpal ri bcas kyi gras shig kyang yin/dgon pa 'di phyag 'de bas pa po ni chos rgyal gter 103

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/bdag gling pa yin tshi nga / khong1646lor yul gra nang rig pa'i 'byung gnas rtakye dar rgyas gling du 'khrungs pa dang /khong1676lo nas /skren grol gling gtsug lag khang rgya khyon ka ba brgyad cu gya ba'i/ thog rim gsum pa/ rtse mor gser zangs kyi gañdzi ra dang li ma lha khang gi rten du gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis/ phyi rol du 'khor sa brang khang dang bcas pa legs par bskruX da/ 168 4chos ra lhun po lte ba rgya khyon ka ba lnga bcu/ thog rim gsum pa/ dbu rtser gser zangs kyi rgya phibs dang babucas pa/ mdun gyi lan gan la gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan /gnyis/ phyi rol du khang bran du mas mdzes pa gsar ba'eng ma dang / yang 1691lor sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo/ rtsa ba nas rtse mo'i chos 'khor bcu gsum gyi bar dpang thog tshad bcu gcig phyogs mtshams gzhan rnams su byang chub mchod rten lhag ma bdun dang /de'i phyi rol du chos bzang bde yangs dang bcas par gsar bzhengs mdzad pa dang / 1696lor bla brang chos 'khor lhun po'i yang thog ar las dbu btsugs/ nge rjes170 0lor sgrub mchod gsang sngags pho brang rgya khyon ka ba bzhi bcu zhe brgyad rten dang brten pa bcas pa legs par bzhengs pa sogs mdzad 'phrin bla na med pa bskyangs/gzhan yang smin grol gling dgon pa ni chos lugs tsam du ma 104

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/zad bod kyi rig pa'i gnas kun sbyong brdar byed sa'i slob grwa chen mo zhig dang mtshungs pas sngar dgon pa 'di nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la byang chub pa'i mkhas dbang mang du byon pa dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtse slob grwa'i dge rgan gcig kyang dgon pa 'di nas gtong dgos kyi yod/gra nang byams pa gling gi mchod rten/mchod rten 'di ni lho kha sa khul gra nang rdzong nas bar thag spyi le gnyis lhag tsam gyi ri ldebs shig la yod pa'i dpal byams nga/ gling dgon pa'i nang du yod/mchod rten gyi mtshan la mchod rten chen mo mthong bas rnam par grol ba zhes zhu ba 'di ni blo bzang grags pa'am tsong kha pa'i thugs sras par+ṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal gyis(thu ri/ lhun bkras)rab byung brgyad pa'i chu 'brug( 1672)lor phyag btab cing / mchod rten der ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i gzugs dbyibs dang mtho tshad thog brtsegs bcu bdun lhag tsam yod pa dang / mchod rten gyi rtsa bar sbom tshad lag 'dom nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod/mchod rten gyi rten gtso sku rgyu gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa dgung lo brgyad pa longs sku'i cha byad 105

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/can/ rigs lnga gser zangs kyis brgyan zhing gzungs gzhug la rdo rje pha lam dang / gzi/ g.yu byur sogs pa rin po che du mas bkang ba bzhugs/de bzhin mchod rten gyi chos 'khor bcu gsum yang gser zangs spus legs las grub cing / mchod rten gyi bre la thog brtsegs gcig dang / bum pa'i rgya khyon ni dge 'dun pa lnga brgya lhag tsam la mnyam du 'tshogs thub cing bum pa'i phyogs bzhir lha khang re yod pa'i nang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba dang / rin bral gyi sku gsung thugs rten mang po yod/ da dung mchod rten dang nye ba'i lho ngos na ka thung nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang ka ring bzhi can gyi thog brtsegs khang chen gsum ldan byams khang zhig yod pa de'i nang sku rgyu gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan thog brtsegs gnyis can dang / sku rgyu dngul las grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang thog tshad gcig can de'i dbu rgyan dang mgul rgyan phyag gdub/zhabs gdub bcas ni gser btso sbyangs las grub pa zhig yin/ gzhan yang mchod rten chen mo 'di'i bum ldir nang du sangs rgyas stong sku dang li sku mang po/ khyad par du sangs rgyas 'od srung sogs kyi 'phel gdung dam rdzas ring bsrel mang po bzhugs yod pas mchod rten chen mo 'di mjal ba tsam gyis skye 'gro kun ngan song gi gnas las grol te thar 106

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/pa'i go 'phang thob par grags/mchod rten chen mo 'di bzhengs par lo ha cang mang po 'gor yod pa ni dmangs khrod kyi shod srol du thog mar mchod rten bzhengs pa'i lo pho mo phan tshun bza' tshang du gyur pa'i phru gus mchod rten bzhengs ma tshar gong las gar zhugs thub kyi yod ces ngag nas ngag brgyud de gleng /mchod rten bzhengs tshar rjes rab gnas rten 'brel mdzad sgo gra ha cang rgyas po zhig gnang ba ste/ thog mar bod zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin rgyal gling tshogs pa dang /tshong 'dus tshogs pa/ snye mdo dgon/ ri bo rnam rgya'// gra thang dgon sogs lhan du rang rang gi chos lugs byed sgo ltar rab gnas cho ga rgyas par gnang ba dang tshes nyer gsum nas gnam gang bar dgon pa so so'i ser sbreng / gtor rgyaga'acham/ go pa dang gzhas chen/ bro/ lha mo sogs ston mo gzab rgyas/ gnam gang nyin byams pa gdan 'dren/ tshes gcig nas dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ kha bal kong 'brug mdo smad sgang drug rgya bod hor gsum sogs bung ba pad mtshor 'du ba bzhin mchod rten legs grub kyi mdzad sgo'i rten 'brel thog rang rang gi yul zog 'khyer nas tshong gnyer byed par yong / dus de nas bzung lo ltar bod zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung sa phyogs gang sa gang nas rang rang so so'i 107

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/thon rdzas 'khyer nas 'char can lho kha gra nang rdzong byams pa gling la tshong rgyag par yong gi yod pas rim ba'in gra nang byams pa gling tshong 'dus zhes ljongs phyi nang gang sar skad grags yod pa'i tshong 'dus chetsha mo zhig tu 'gyur/ bal po'i tshong pa sogs kyis mchod rten gyi rtse nas dar dpyang ka shi dkar po gtong gi yod pas phyis mi tshos ka shi ring thung la bltas nas snam bu'i gong che chung tshod dpag thub kyi yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni bal po sogs kyi chong pa mang ba yod pa ka shi ring ba yod pa dang snam bu nyo mkhan mang ba yod pas snam gong 'phar ba dang / ka shi thung ba yod na snam bu nyo mkhan nyung bar brten snam gong chag gi yod/byams pa gling dgon pa'i lo ltar 'char can gyis dus ston der chos phyogs nas byams pa gling smon lam zhes zer ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i phyogs nas byams pa gling tshong 'dus 'es zer gyi yod la 'brug yul sogs nas kyang byams pa gling dgon par phyag mchod dang / dge 'dun par mang ja dang sku 'gyed sogs 'bul srol yod/byams pa gling dgon pa'i bla brgyud sku phreng dang po blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / de nas dpon char rwa dga'/rnam grol rin po che/ blo bzang bu chung / blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs rgyun mi chad par byung yod/108

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/rdzing phyi dgon/mtshan cha tshang la rdzing phyi dga' ldan byams gling zhes zhu 'ing rtsed thang nas spyi le8 0tsam song na rdzing phyi dgon par slebs/ rdzing phyi zhes pa ni grong ming yin pa dang thog mar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi bka' ltar khams nas phebs pa'i sgar mi yon tan g.yung drung gis phyag btab/ dgon pa'i rten gtso dzi k+ṣim 'a sa grub pa'i sku gdung dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad kyi thugs gar tsan dan de ba'i nags khrod nas 'khrungs pa'i tsan dan gyi byams pa khru gang bzhugs pa byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba 'ig yod/ thog mar dgon pa de dar rgyas che ba'i skabs dge 'dun 'al grangs lnga brgya skor zin na'ang rim bzhin nyams rgud du song bas rje tsong kha pa la rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis lung bstan pa ltar gnas der phebs skabs der rten gtso byams pa'i dbu la bya brun dang / thal rdul gyis khengs shing / gtsug lag khang yang bog por gyur yod pa gzigs rjes thugs skyo nas rang dbang med par spyan chab kyang shor/ de nas 'ol kha stag rtse rdzong gis tsong kha pa'i thugs re ltar sbyin bdag zhus nas nyams gso legs par mdzad/ rje rang nyid kyi gtor chas 109

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/btsongs pas dngul phran bu byung ba spyad de rgyal chen rnam thos sras la smon skul zhus pas ltung bshags lha sum cu so lnga 'bri mi dgos par rang byung lhun gyis grub ste gyang ldebs su gsal ba da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod pa ni ches ngo mtshar che ba dang ches byin rlabs che ba zhig yod pa smos ci/ rdzing phyi dgon dang byams par nyams gso gnang ba de ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher shin tu sman pa'i mdzad pa zhig yin pas rje rin chen po che'i mdzad chen bzhi'i ya gyal zhig yin/gzhan yang rdzing phyi dgon par ma slebs gong gi spyi le bcu tsam gyi sar 'ol dga' rdzong yod cing / yul der 'ol dga' zer don ni/ lho ngos su srid pa'i lha chen 'o de gung rgyal zhes pa'i gangs ri star chags su yod pa las rtse mo mtho zhing phra bas kha sprod du gnas yod pa ni yab yum gnyis dang /gnyan chen thang lha dang / kong btsun de mo/ mon yul de mo/lho brag sku lha mkha'i ri/ yar lha sham bu/ jo mo mkha' regabadud rtsi sman mo/ stag stod shing bya sogs 'o lde gung rgyal gyi sras sros yin par grags pas lung pa'i ming la'ang 'o lde gung rgyal gyi sgra'i dod las 'ol kha zhes zer/110

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/rdo rje brag dgon pa/mtshan cha tshang la thub bstan rdo rje brag e wam lcog sgar zhes zhu/dgon de'i mchan 'grel ni rgyab rir g.yu yi rdo rje'i rang byon yod pas rdo rje brag dang / e wam lcog sgar zhes pa ni thog mar lcog gur phub pa'i 'dus sde yin pas mtshan de ltar thogs/de yang thog mar mnga' ris paṇ+ḍi ta pad ma dbang gi rgyal pos gur bskyon pa'i gsang chen gyi 'dus sde chung ngu zhig 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa dang / de rjes sku phreng gsum pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang pos phyag btab/rig 'dzin sku phreng ba'i pa kun bzang pad ma 'phrin las khrir 'khod rjes rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po dang chos yon gyi thugs rje'i bdag rkyen dang bcas stobs rgyas par gyur/bde yangs shar nub gnyis zhes ma do sngags grwa tshang shar nub gnyis yod/ de snga dge 'dun 'al grangs lnga stong tsam byung myong yod pas snga 'gyur rnying ma'i byang gter gyi gdan sa chen por grags/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus 'gor jun 111

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gar dmag gis dgon de rmeg med du bzo ba'i skabs mgon khang srid gsum rnam rgyal bshig par brtsam pa'i dus jun gar ba'i dmag dpon khrag skyugs te shi bas skrag ste ma gon khang de gcig pu ma bshig par ba'ag gser zangs las grub pa'i sku brnyan chu la bskyur ba dang / gse ra bris kyi bka' 'gyur sogs nang rten mang po 'khyer zhing dgung grangs bdun cu don bdun la phebs pa'i rig 'dzin pad ma/ 'phrin las kyang bkrongs pa sogs bar chad shugs/ chen byung yang rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa'i skabs dgon pa'i bdag dbang mtha' dag slar gso gnang ba dang / de nas bzung phyi'i bkod pa dang nang gi thugs rten rim ba'in nyams gso dang gsar bskrun byas pas sngar dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i grags can gyi rnying dgon 'ig tu 'gyur/rdo rje brag dgon pa'i mdun du ya ra klung gtsang po rgyu ba dang / rgyab tu ba gam brag ris mdzes par brgyan yo/da pas bod kyi dmangs khrod glu ga'as nang du'ang rdo rje brag gi rgyab ri/ / rgyab ri brag la bcol yo/da/ / brag 'a 'gyur ba ma/ gtong / / thang dkar snang bzod bde ba/ / ( snang bzod bde ba dang gnas bzod bde ba 'es 'bri stangs gnyis yod kyang 'dir gong ma der go dgos) rdo rje brag gi ma dun phyogs/ / mdun phyogs mtsho la bcol yo da/ / mtsho la 112

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/'gyur ba ma gtong / / gser nya snang bzod bde ba/ / zhes gtong dang gtong ba'in yo da do/ /e lha rgya ri pho brang /rtsed thang nas shar lho'i phyogs su spyi le50tsam phyin na chu gsum rdzong khongs su yin pa'i e lha rgya ri pho brang du slebs shing / pho brang de ni thog mar spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis par pur btsan po'i gdung rgyud las mched pa'i sa gnas sring dbang 'dzin mkhan gyi khyim rgyud chen po sde pa rgya ri ba'i rgyud rabs kyis gsar du bskrun pa zhig red/ de yang lha zhes pa ni lha sras btsan po'i gdung rgyud las mched pa yin pas lha zhis dang / rgya bo zhes pa ni bod kyi btsan po'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa yar klung jo bo'i brgyud du rgya ri khri chen khri thog dang po lha dgra las rnam rgyal gyis e stod si'u chu tshan khar slebs te de gar bzhugs gnas chung ngu zhig brtsigs nas bzhugs dus nyin zhig nye 'dabs kyi ri la me 'bar ba gzigs pas ya mtshan du dgongs nas dpyad pa mdzad skabs rtswa rgya bo rang byung gi me 'bar ba de ni bkra shis pa'i snga ltas shig yin pa mkhyen nas gnas der dgon pa dang gzhis ka so gas brtsigs pas rgya ri dgon zhes ming du chags/ de 1 /3

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/nas rim par rgya ri sku thog rim byung gis pho brang rgya bskyed nyams gso mdzad pas e lha rgya ri'i pho brang zhes gangs ljongs yongs la rlung ltar grags pa de byung /de yang lha rgya ri'i pho brang ni gad pa thog brtsegs nyi shu tsam yod pa'i sa bab ngo mtshar can zhig gi steng du chags shing / pho brang lte ba'i bzo skrun zheng tshad rmid21dang ring tshad rmid2 2mtho tshad thog brtsegs lnga yod pa'i mdun ngos su dkar gzhal zhes pa 'khyams shin tu che ba zhig yod pa de'i mtha' skor du rdo tshos gzhi 'dra min sna tshogs bsgrigs pa'i mdzes ris bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon sna lnga sogs kyis phyugs pa rgya khyon yangs shing mdzes sdug lta bas mi ngoms pa zhig yod/ da dung rdzong zur zhes pa thog brtsegs bzhi ldan gyi khang pa dmar po zhig yod pa de ni ring lha rgyal mtshan gyi mgon khang yin pa dang /gzhan yang pho brang gi byang ngos grog shur nang du lha rgya ri khri thog mjug ma rnam rgyal rgya mtshos1948lor bzhengs pa'i dbyar skyid spro khang rgya bzo'i lugs bzo dbyibs legs la sge'u khung dang bcad khra sogs la shing brkos bya 'brug dang /rtsi shing me tog gi ri mo mdzes par brgyan pa'i khang bzang gi khor mo yug spang ljongs dang / me tog sna tshogs/ 'bras ldan ljon shing sogs kyis yongs su bskor ba de ni lha sa'i 114

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/nor bu gling kha gnyis pa yin zhes yongs su grags pa don dang mthun/des na lha rgya ri pho brang gi lo rgyus rin thang dang / bzo skrun sgyu rtsal/ gnas yul khyad chos sogs bod yul na mthong bar dkon pa zhig yin pas rgya ri pho brang 'di nyid lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin par bsnyon du med do/ /'on ke ru lha khang /rtsed thang nas nya mgo zam chen brgal te byang ngos 'on yul gyi phu la spyi le bdun tsam bskyod na ke ru lha khang du slebs shing / lha khang de ni thog mar chos rgyal khri gtsug brtan gyis bzhengs gnang mdzad pa dang / de rjes bla ma skyes chen du mas zhabs kyis bcags shing / byin gyis brlabs pa'i lho kha'i yar klung gtsang po'i byang ngos kyi byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba'i lha khang rnying pa zhig yin pa dang / lhag par du jo bo rje gnas der phebs nas yun ring tsam bzhugs shing /de nas slar yang byon par nye ba'i skabs skye bo skya ser kun gyis mgrin gcig tu jo bo ma phebs rogs gnang / jo bo ma phebs rogs gnang zhes yang nas yang du zhus pas jo bos nga 115

bod ljongs lho kha'i yu la skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/ma phyin na mi 'grig pas nga'i tshab tu 'di nyar tshags byos 'es gsu ngas nas shangs khrag gis 'dra sku cig bzhengs gnang mdzad pa dang / jo bos nyin ltar sgom nas bzhugs sar 'bas dang / phyag dbu sogs kyi rjes yod pas mchod rten 'ig bzhings pa de la mchod rten dkar chung lha khang 'es zer/lo rgyus 'ga' 'ig nang lha khang de'i mtshan la brag dmar ke ru lha khang zhes 'khod yod kyang / brag dmar zhes pa ni bas ma yas la go dgos pas bsam yas dang ke ru lha khang 'o rgyus thad 'brel ba ci yang med pa ma zad lo tshigs kyang mi mthun/ lo rgyus dngos pha gtam bu 'jags su gyur pa'i ke ru lha khang gi mtshan rnying par 'on khra sna ke ru lha khang zhes zer cing / de yang khra sna zhes pa ni grong tsho'i ming rnying pa yin par bsnyon du med/da dung mkhas dbang 'ga' zhig gis ke ru lha khang ni mu ne btsan po'i dus bzhengs par yang bzhid mkhan yod/mig sngar lha khang de'i nang zhugs pa'i sman 'dam las grub pa'i sku 'dra rnying pa de dag la thun min gna' bo'i bzo rtsal khyad chos ldan pa dang / bstan 'gyur bris ma pod nyis brgya lhag tsam yod pa de dag kyang ches rnying ma sha stag yin pas lha khang der lo rgyus 'ib 'jug gi rin thang ga'an gyis 116

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/bsgrun du med pa 'ig mchis so /yar 'brog bsam sdings dgon pa/yar 'brog bsam sdings dgon pa ni bsam sdings rdo rje phag mo sku phreng dang po chos kyi sgron mes rab byung bdun pa'i lcags sprel ( 1 4 4 0 ) lor phyag btab/ dgon pa'i mtshan cha tshang la dpal mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i bsti gnas bsam grub kyis chos kyi sdings zhes zer zhing / 'di ni bod ljongs su bud med kyi bla mas yang srid rim byon dgon bdag byed mkhan gcig rang yod pa de yin/ de yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir yul rtsa ba'i zhes grags pa'i nang tshan/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i bste gnas chen po 'di nyid bod gangs can gyi ljongs/ dbus gtsang gnyis kyi mtshams/ yar 'brog g.yu ma tsho phyug mo mdun du yon chab phul ba ltar 'khyil 'ing /phyogs bzhi mu khyud ri bos mdzes par bskor ba dang / khor mo yug tu mar gad zhun ma/'i mdangs can rtswa ljang ne'u gseng ldem/ ldem g.yo ba'i dbus su/ ri bo glang chen mtsho chu 'thung ba'i dbyibs legs lta bu'i steng du brjid chags rnam par bkra ba'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid gnas/ dgon pa'i 'du khang legs bshad dga' tshal zhes bya ba'i rten gtso gser 117

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/zangs kyi thub dbang 'dul ma thog so gnyis pa/ gzungs su sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel sogs bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs tshan kha 'bar bas gtsos dgon pa 'di na/ rje btsun mi pham mgon po dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du bzhugs pa'i snang brnyan phra ldan byon gtsang dang / lha babs mchod rten/ bka' gdams mchod rten/ byang chub mchod rten sogs sum brgya/ gnas bdag zhing skyong yab yum gnyis tsā ri nas bro pa pho mor sprul nas phebs dus kyi rnga chung / grub thob thang stong rgyal pos gnang ba'i tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i rdo rje rnam 'byor ma/ mu tig brgyad stong sogs sku gsung thugs rten bgrang gis mi lang zhing / lhag par du nang rten la 'tshe ba'i gor dmag gi mgo lag mnan pa'i steng du bzhengs pa'i dngul gdung byang chub mchod rten 'di 'dra bod yongs su mthong ba dkon/ de bzhin bla brang gi rgyu dngos 'jog sa'i khang pa/ 'dod rgu bang mdzod bkar steng zhes pa'i nang g.yang sgam dang / za 'og gos dar/ glang chen gyi mche ba/ bse ru'i rwa co/ khyung gi sder mo/ rta'i rwa co/ g.yu byur/ gzi/ mu tig bod dngul ṭam rkyal sogs rin thang bral ba'i nor bu'i rigs dang / de min phyi nang bar gsum gyi dpal 'bar la sus kyang 'gran par dka' ba dper na/ khang pa grangs nyis brgya bdun cu don gsum la 118

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/ka ba lnga brgya sum cu so gcig dang / phyugs rigs dkar nag mgo grangs chig khri nyis stong brgya dang bdun cu don lnga yod pa lta bu red/bsam sdings dgon par rdo rje pha mo sku phreng bcu gnyis byung ba dang / mig sngar sku phreng bcu gnyis pa bde chen chos kyi sgron ma mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i ngang 'tsho 'ing bzhes so/ /gdan sa mthil dgon pa/gdan sa mthil dgon pa ni yar klung gtsang po'i byang ngos/ lho kha zangs ri rdzong khongs/ phag mo gru pa grong tsho'i ri ldebs su gnas/ de yang phag mo zhes pa ni grong tsho'i ming dang gru pa ni gru kha'i ming yin pas bsdus ming la phag mo gru pa zhes brjod/ chos lugs kyi 'grel bshad ltar na phag gru zhes pa'i go don sngar gnas der rdo rje phag mos dngos su byin brlabs pa'i gnas rtsa chen zhig yin/dgon pa 'di thog mar rgya sgom rmi ras kyi sbyin bdag mdzad de mnyam po dwags po lha rje'i slob ma rang nyid dang ma/tshungs pa phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal pos rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag ( 1 15nga) lor phyag btab cing / de nas bzung dpal phag mo gru pa bka' brgyud ces yongs su grags/119

bod ljongs lho kha'i yu la skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gdan sa ma thil gnas sa'i ri bo mtho 'ing / brag ri dwangs shel spungs pa lta bu'i mdun na sna ma/nga me tog gi dri 'im gang sa ra thu'/ ba dang / nags tshal stug ngo/'i khrod du spu sdug bya rigs kyi gsung snyan lhang lhang sgrog cing / ri dwags sna tshogs 'tshe med ci gar rgyu ba sogs bsam gtan gyi gnas bag phebs pa'i yi gar 'ong ba 'ig yin/dus rabs rim byung nang bka' brgyud kyi bsta na pa 'dzin pa phag gru dang / 'bri gung / stag lung so gas kyi skye bo dam pa rnams kyis dgon pa nyams gso dang / rgya bskyed sogs thengs kha shas gnang ba brgyud ga'i nas rgya khyon che zhing / rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten gyis yongs su bkang ba'i dgon chen cig tu gyur nas mtshan snyan yul gru kun tu khyab/dgon pa 'di ni chos lugs tsam ma zad phag mo/ gru pas bod dbang bsgyur byed pa'i skabs su chab srid thad la'ang gal che'i gnas bab bzung yod pa'i dgon pa 'ig yi na/phag gru rdo rje rgyal po nas bzung gdan rabs kyang skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po dang / rgyal ba rin po che spyan snga sku thog bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rje sogs mang du byon/dgon pa'i ming gdan sa mthil 'es zer ba'i nang gi mthil zhes pa ni bod kyi skad yig nang spyir btang gshong sar 120

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/go dgos pa'i skabs shig yod kyang 'dir dkyil lam lte bar dgos pa ste/ phag gru bka' rgyud kyi gdan sa'i lte ba zhes pa'i don yin/dgon pa 'di btab pa nas bzung bod kyi dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs tshos ga'an las lhag pa'i gnas rtsa chen 'ig tu brtsis nas dad sems bla med zhu gi yod cing /dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig nang du'ang gzhon pa 'di ru ma sdod chas nas 'gro/ gnas chen gdan sa mthil la chas nas 'gro/ phag mo gru pa'i byin rlabs ma zhus na/ 'di dang phyi ma'i las sbib ga la dag ces sogs gtong ngang gtong ba'in pa yin no/4 /dwags lha sgam po dgon/dwags lha sgom po dgon ni gangs can bka' brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po mar mi dwags gsum zhes yongs su grags pa'i ya gyal mnyam med dwags po lha rjes rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags glang ( 118 1) lor phyag btab/ rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le289yod pa dang mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid440 0yod/gnas de ni rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i ri brag tshang 121

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/tshing can ngo mtshar che ba zhig yin pas skyes bu dam pa so sor gzigs snang mi 'dra ba mang po byung myong yod/de yang dgon pa 'debs pa po mnyam med dwags po lha rje ni rab byung dang po'i sa lug( 1 079)lor lho kha'i gnyal khul du(lhun rtse rdzong khongs) sku 'khrungs pa dang / sku gzhon dus gsang yum sras sros dang bcas pa rim ba'in bshegs pas bar gting nas nges 'byung bla lhag tu skyes te rab byung nas mkhas dbang mang po bsten nas chos lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag las sbyangs pa mthil phyin pa mdzad/lhag par du dgung lo so gnyis la phebs skabs rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas gdams ngag rtsa chen gsan te nyams myong gi rtsal thon/ phyis dbus su log phebs khar rje btsun mi la ras pas ched du dwags po lha rje gam du bos nas bu ston pa dbus su bzhugs pa na/ shar sgam po dar gyi ri bo de/ rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/rgyab ri dar dkar yol ba 'dra/ ri bdun blon po tshogs pa 'dra / shing spang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal 'dra/ ri de yi mgul na khyed kyi gdul bya yod/ khyed de ru song nas 'gro don sgrubs/bu khyed kyi bzhed don 'grub nges yin zhes lung du bstan pa ltar dbus su log nas mi ring bar dwags lha dgon phyag 122

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/btab/bka' rtsom yang bka' gdams pa'i lam rim dang /rje mi la'i bka' phyag chen po'i gdams pa gcig tu dril ba'i〈lam rim thar rgyan〉sogs mdzad/ lo gsu ma stan dang ma bral bar sgom pa'i brtson 'grus bskyed pas bzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong / chos thams cad de kho na nyid mkhyen/ slob ma 'ang mtha' yas pa byung nas dwags po bka' brgyud kyi srol gtod/ gtsug lag khang steng shod mtha' 'khor du bcas pa rgya che 'ing bkod pa legs pa kun gyi dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba dang / ngo mtshar yid dbang 'phrog pa'i nang rten du dwags po lha rje'i thugs dam gyi rten rje btsun mi la'i sku/ dwags po lha rje'i sku gsung byon ma/ jo bo rje'i phyag bzo thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyis bzhengs pa'i spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi/ klu sgrub kyi phyag bris grub chen mang po'i phyag brgyud pa/ nā ro pa'i thugs dam gyi rten bde mchog sku thang / mar pa'i phyag bris nā ro pa'i sku thang /be+eḍūr+ya'i glegs bam nyi khri sogs rin thang bral ba'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po yod do/ /123

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/rtsed thang lnga mchod dgon pa dang dga' ldan chos 'khor gling /dgon pa 'di gnyis rtsed thang grong rdal gyi dbus su yod cing sngar skyes chen dam pa mang pos 'bas kyis bcag cing chos gsu ngas myong bas gang sar snyan grags shin tu che/de yang rtsed thang lnga mchod dgon pa ni rab byung bdun pa'i shing rta ( 1 4 1 4) lor phyag btab pa'i bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa zhig yin pa dang snga phyir bla ma skyes chen dam/ pa mang pos chos bskor bskor myong yod la lhag par du rje rin po che dbus gtsang du phebs skabs dgon pa 'dir byon nas tsan dan gyi ka bar sku rgyab bsnyes te bzhugs skabs rje btsun 'jam/ dpal dbyangs kyis dngos su 'al gzigs nas 'jam dpal dbyangs rje rin chen por thims la nye ba'i skabs rje rin po ches nga la ma/ thims/ gyang la thims 'es gsungs pa ltar gyang la thims pas 'jam dbyangs gyang thim/sa ma 'es pa'i gyang dang / jo bo rje'i thugs dam gyi rten thub pa gser gling ma sogs rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten shin tu mang po yod/ khyad par du gangs ljongs gso rig mkhas 124

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/dbang gser ri'i phreng ba'i rgyun 'dzin pa/ rig pa'i klong rdol 'ing / shes rab kyi me lce 'bar ba/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i bstan par mdzad rjes 'gran zla bral zhing nyam/ thag nad pa'i tsha gdung sel ba'i 'chi med lha yi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshe yi rig pa 'dzin pa mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu mchog dgon pa 'di'i dge 'dun pa yin pas khong gi 'dra sku dus da lta'ang gzi 'od mi nyams par mjal rgyu yod pa de la phyogs ba'i'i dad ldan skye bo dang / ljongs rgyu ba chad med 'tshang kha shig shig ngang 'khor ba'in yod do/ /dga' ldan chos 'khor gling dgon ni lnga mchod dgon pa'i shar byang du gnas yod pa dang / dgon pa de'ang thog mar bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa 'ig yin/ de rjes rgyud smad mkhan chen dpal 'byor grags pas rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dge lugs pa'i phyag bzhes gnang zhing dar rgyas gong 'phel du gtong gnang mdzad/rten gtso byin can mi dbang byams pa sogs shin tu mang la dga' ldan chos 'khor gling dgon pa'i gna' bo'i 'dzugs skrun gyi brjid nyams dang / sgyu rtsal/ khyad chos sogs dbus su dkar gsal zla ba ltar ngoms pa dang /de'i mtha' skor du gna' bo'i grong rdal rnying pa rtsed thang gi yul mi'i khang pa skar tshogs lta bus yongs su bskor yod/125

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gra thang dgon pa/gra thang dgon pa ni lho sa khul gra nang rdzong du gnas shing / dgon pa 'di spyi lo1081lor gter ston grwa pa mngon shes kyis phyag btab/ de yang gter ston grwa pa mngon shes(dbang phyug 'bar)ni spyi lo10 12lor gra nang skyid ru zhes par sku 'khrungs pa dang1090lor sku gshegs shing /khong gis snga phyir gra thang sogs gnas gzhi brgya dang brgyad bzhengs zhes yongs su grags/thog mar dgon pa 'di'i chos lugs bka' gdams pa yin rung / dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang mkhan po kun dga' mkhyen brtse phun tshogs zhes snyan grags can zhig byung ba de'i skabs sa skya par bsgyur 'duganye ba'i dus te spyi lo1926lo rgyal tshab ra sgreng rdo rje 'chang lha mo'i bla mtshor gzigs par phebs skabs yar lam gra thang dgon par gzigs 'ib mdzad skabs gna' bo'i gtsug lag khang 'di bzhin nyams gog che bar brten nyams gso gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes thob pa ltar1929lor nyams gso 'go btsugs/126

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/da wa da gra thang dason pa'i dpu rtse rigs bkasu nga / dang / 3lor sa phyi nang so gas bzo dbyibs spyir na bsam yas dgon nga dang 'dra po yod pas dgon pa'i ming la'ang gra thang zhes sgra 'gyur ba red ces shod rgyu yod /dgon pa 'di'i nang rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po yo da pa dang da dung 'ang blon zhes pa g.ya ga mgo'i gzugs/ su yo/da pa 'ig de'i dbu rwa g.ya/sa/ pa de grwa mngon gyis bsam ya/sa dge rgyas li ma'i gling nas gter nas spyan drangs pa dang / dbu rwa g.yon ma dang da bu byings ni tsan dan dkar dam/ra las/ grung cing / ya/ra rje o rgyan gling pa'i phyag bzo dngos yin pa dang hro/ga shing de klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen gyis ngu/la ngar grags pas kun gyis 'ang blon la dad gus tshad med byas te gra nang khul gyi mis ma na' bskyal dus kyang 'ang blon tshad btsugs zhis zer gyi yod/ lhag par du gra thang dgon pa'i nang gi ldebang ba bris khag gcig lo rgyungo5 shin tu ring 'ing sgyu rtsal yang rtser so /na pa dang da migs bsa'/ gyi khyad chos yo da pas gang sar skad grags yed/

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen/'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen ni lho kha 'phyongs rgyas rdzong khongs phying ba stag rtse'i nye 'gram glang chen sa la nya' ba dang 'dra ba'i ri ldebs su chags yod/ rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le28 ོ/da pa dang mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid28 0 0yod/ dgon pa 'di dge lugs pa'i bla ma mkhan chen nyi khri 'dzin pa blo gros dpal bzang po 'es pas spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu ba'i'i nang phyag btab pa zhig yin pas lho kha sa khul du yod pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa ches snga shos kyi gas shig yin/ thog mar dgon pa der dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu don lnga yod cing chos srid gnyis ga'i bdag po blo gros dpal bzang yin pa dang lhag par du khong gis chos phyogs kyi nyaphyo4sa len bka' khrid sogs legs par mdzad pas slob ma'ang rim bzhin mang du so nga /mkhan thog dang po blo gros dpal bzang gshegs rjes khong gi dngos slob 'od snang chen pos mkhan po mdzad pa dang / skabs der tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho yang bde chen dgon du 'bas sor 'khod de chos 128

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/phyogs bka' slob gnang ba dang 'brel tshig sbyor du dngar ba'i ja mchod cig kyang dzi gas rtsom gnang ba phyis gdan sa chen po gsum gyi gtsos dgon sde khag mang por 'don dang 'angon ba'in pa yin/rgyal dbang lnga pas chos srid thugs 'gan bzhes rjes dgon pa ri bo bde chen la thugs khur bla med mdzad de 'du khang gsar bzhings gnang ba ma zad smon tshig phyag bris phyag bstar ma'ang gnang zhing de rjes lam smon zab mo'i mtshams sbyor gyis bsod nams dar rgyas zhes pa'i pho gsar spyang grung ldan pa 'ig ri bo bde chen du byon nas dgon pa'i skyid sdug nang zhugs/ lo shas song rjes khong dgon pa'i don du khams phyogs 'a drel pa'i lag rogs su phebs skabs blo bzang chos mdzes zhis pa'i dman shar yid du 'ong ba 'ig dang lus 'brel byung bar tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa sku 'khrungs pas khong rnam gnyis rgyal yab dang rgyal yum du gyur/ de rjes tā ma'i sku phreng bdun pa rgya nag tu phebs skabs gong mas dad gus bla na med pa zhus nas sku chas sogs 'bor chen phul ba ma zad ri bo bde chen dgon par gdan sa chen po ga'an dang 'dra bar gong ma rim byon dang / tā la'i bla ma rim byung gis rgyab skyor dang mthong chen gnang gi yod pas snga phyir 'du khang dang / byams khang/ gnas bcu lha khang 129

—— bod ljongasalho kha'i yu la sloraganasaljongasaboldi da —sogs rgya bskyed shin tu cher ngo byed thub pa byung 'ing dung mtshungs nang rten byim can dang / rgyal ba'i gsu nga rab thang ga sogs rtsa che'i rig dngos grangs kyis mi la nga ba yod pa'i nang rgya nag gong mas phu' ba'i gnas bcu lha khang gi rten gtso gser zangs 'a sa grub pa'i rje tsong kha pa mi tshad tsam dang / gnas bcu'i 'al thang so gas rin thang bra' ba'ang khag gcig yod/ bar lam dgon pa der nyams chag shugs chen byung yang da lta mchod mjal dang gzigs skor gnang sa ha cang yag po yod/dwags po bshad sgrub gling dgon/rtsed thang nas chu gsu/ma rdzong brgyung po thang la brgyab nas spyi le1 3khasong ba na rgya tsha rdzo nga lo/ ngas dwags ngo grum pa dang nye sar dgon pa nge gnas yo da nga/ dang mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid ༈ 2 5 0 yod/nge yang thog ma/ra ngargocha pa de chags yul du laro pa sku phreng dgu pas phya ga/ btab sanang ba'i bka' brgyud pa'i dason nga tshis yo da kyang bar chang kyis thor 'ig tu song /de rjes dga' lnga na khri/ thog bdun pa blo gros brtan pas chu'i phar phyosas brag ste nga es nga/ra dge lu4sa nga/'i dason 130

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/chung 'ig phyag btab/ dgon chung de'i dge 'dun rnams chos gzhis sogs skyo bas gang sar bsod snyoms su phebs skabs e lha rgya ri dang chos yon sbyin bdag tu gyur pas dgon pa'ang da lta'i gnas 'dir spos pa dang rim bzhin gra rgyas su song nas mnga' dwags rgyal gsum zhes('on mnga' ris grwa tshang / dwags lha sgam po dgon/ chos 'khor rgyal dgon)yongs su grags/phyis dwags lha sgam po'i dge 'dun rnams lo ltar e lha rgya rir zla ba gnyis re 'char can gsung chos su/ phebs dgos pa dang e lha rgya ri nas bsnyen bkur 'bas/ tog bla na meng pa gnang gi yong /dgon pa 'di'i 'dul ba'i bca' khrim/sa shin tu dam po yo da pas de sngon gang sar dwags lha sgam po dgon gyi 'dul khrims rbi/ sangs rgyas 'al bzhugs skabs nyan thos kyi bcad pa dang 'dra ('dul khrims dang 'dra zer bar go dgos)zhis dad smon zhu gi yong/ don dngos su'ang de 'a dra rang yin pa dper na/ dge 'dun pas shag chas kyang rdza dang / shing / lcags bcas las/ gser dang / dngul/zangs/ rag sogs gtan nas nyar mi chog pa de 'dra bod yo ngas kyi dgon pa'i nang mthong dkon pa zhig red/dge 'dun yang 'al grangs bdun brgya skor yod pa 131

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/las byes pa dang gzhis pa gnyis su dbye nas byes pa lnga brgya phyogs gzhan du phebs srol dang / ga'is pa nyis brgya dgon par gtan bzhugs gnang gi yod/dgon pa de'i rten gtso gser zangs las grub pa'i thub pa'i dbang po sku tshad thog brtsegs gsum ldan gyi thugs kur nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs pa 'khor nyan thos gnyis dang nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor ba sogs rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po mjal rgyu yod/smra bo lcog dgon pa/smra bo lcog dgon pa ni lho kha sa khul mtsho smad rdzong khongs su gnas yod cing dgon pa de ni spyi lo'i dus rabs 1 1pa'i nang nyi zla ltar grags pa'i gter ston gong 'og gnyis las gong ma nyang ral nyi ma 'od zer gyis phyag btab/de yang gter ston chen po nyang ral nyi ma 'od zer ni spyi lo1 1 2 4lor sku 'khrungs pa dang spyi 'o 1 1kha2lor sku gshegs shing / khong gi sku tshe gcig ring bstan don dang 'gro don bskyangs nas snga phyir gter rdzas mang po spyan drangs pa dang / dgon pa rgya bskyed/ slob ma gso skyong / de ba'in bka' gter gnyis chu bo gcig tu 'dres par mdzad pa 132

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/sogs/ snga 'gyur bstan pa 'a mdzad pa shin tu che/dgon pa ('dir gdung rabs rim byung gi thog ma 'gro mgon nam mkha' dpal ba nas lo shas gong gshegs ma thag pa'i kun bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bar mi rabs nyi shu byung ba'i ring sku gsung thugs rten rtsa chen mang po bsdu rub dang /nyar tshags// gsar bzhengs bcas gnang ba'i nang spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi sogs rang byon du ma dang / nyang gi phyag 'khar/ bal bris thang ga thog tshad yan brgya dang brgyad/sku tshab gter lnga dang nyer lnga/ gnam lcags kyi rdo rje che chung gnyis/ thugs sras 'gro mgon gyi dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i gdung rten thog tshad lhag tsam la gzi dang / mu tigagayu/ byu ru/ spos shel/ pad rag mar gad/ en+d+ra nī la sogs rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab par brgyan pa/ khyad par du bka' dgu'i lha tshogs sku rgyab ldeb bris khrag bon(khrag thigs) khri cho tsam nam rgyun tshang ma skam po yin yang bstan srid 'tshub cha yong mtshams rlon pa shar ba dang /thigs pa rgyag pa gogs bka' shin tu gnyan pa mjal rgyu yod/sngar ma dgon smra bo lcog la dbus gtsang khams gsum la dgon lag bco brgyad yo da cing chos brgyud dar khyab che 'ing /lo rgyus ring ba sogs/ dgon pa 'di ni 'brog khul du gnas pa'i rnying ma 'i dgon pa skad grags/ che shos kyi gras shig yin/133
