bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/ sdings po che dgon/rtsed thang nas gra nang rdzong brgyud spyi le5 0tsam bskyod na gra nang nub ri'i ri sked man tsam la gnas pa'i sdings po che dgon par slebs/ dgon pa de ni thog mar rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i slob ma yang dgon zhu ba de'i gdan sa zhig yod pa la phyis 'brug pa pad ma dkar po dang / sems dpa' rin chen dpal bzang sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs shing / rgya bskyed mdzad pa dang khyad par du 'brug pa pad ma dkar po'i dngos slob dpa' rin chen dpal bzang gis cog grwa 'dzugs mdzad pa rim bzhin dar rgyas chen po byung bas de nas bzung dgon de'i bla ma rim byung la cog grwa rin po che zhes mtshan gsol/lo rgyus thog dgon pa de nas grub rtags tshad du 'khyol ba'i skyes bu dam pa mang du byon zhing / lo ltar dgon pa'i rgyab kyi ri rtse'i phug par sgrub pa bskyon mkhan shin tu mang po yod pa de 'dra ni gra nang tsam ma zad lho kha yongs la'ang mthong dkon pa zhig yin/dgon pa de'i nang rin thang bral ba'i 'al thang rnying ma/ 134

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/—sogs sku gsung thugs rten ji snyed cig bzhugs yod 'a dason pa'ang grong dang ma 'dres pa khor yu/ga sa gtsang chu gtsang chos bsha' ma bya sa 'i gnas ngo ma/tshar can zhig yin pas skye bo su zhig gnas der slebs/ pa tsam gyis dam pa'i chos la bcos min dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ ba'i kun slong tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba 'ig dbang med skye gi yod/mig sngar sdings po che dgon pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can cog grwa chos kyi seng gi rin po ches bshad grwa lung rig smra ba'i dga' tshal gsar 'dzugs gnang zhing mdo khams yul nas nges pa 'don gyi mkhas pa chen po mkhan po bkra shis bstan pa rab rgyas mchog gdan drangs te thar 'dod ngur smrig mdangs ldan gzhon dar khyu tshogs dbu tshad/bsdus gsum gyis gtsos bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs brtson gyis rgyal pa'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams gong 'phel gyi mdzad 'phrin rgyas ba'in yod pas rtasna na pa'i grags pa slar yang gang sar khyab ste phyogs gang sa gang nas dam chos don gnyer mkhan dang / mchod mjal gzibs skor gnang mkhan bung ba pad mtshor 'jug pa bzhin ('tshang kha shig shig ngang phebs ba'in yo/da/135

bod ljongs lho kha'i yu 'a skor gnas ljongs ngo spro nga/sne gdong rtse tshogs pa dgon dang ban tshang dgon/sne gdong zhes pa ni grong ming yin pa dang / dgon pa ri'i ri rgyud g.yon ngos su ri glang chen nya0/ 'dra'i sme mo ra chags pas sne gdong 'es zer/sne gdong rtse tshogs pa dgon pa ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis par kha che paṇa chen dang khong gi dngos slob byang rdor gnyis kyi phyag btab pa'i tshogs pa sde ba'i'i ya gyal zhig yin/dgon 'di'i rten gtso grags can sgrol ma gsung byon da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod pa de ni sngon rgya gar du kha che paṇa chen gyis mu stegs par rtsod pa nyin bdun bskyon dus nyin lnga pham/ pas thugs yid mug ste shing tā la'i sdong po 'ig tu sku bstes nas bzhugs pas sdong po de'i steng nas lo ma 'ig lhung ba yar sgrug nas gzigs skabs lo ma de'i ngos sgro' ma phyag bache pa rang byon zhig yod pa des paṇa chen paṇa chen/ byed kyis sngar ba'in rtsod cig ces gsung byon pa ltar rtsod nga/ bskyon pas paṇa chen rgyal bas// sgro'/ ma de'i ma/tshan la'ang 136

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/sgro la ma rtsod rgyal zhes gso la/ de nas bzung rtse tshogs dgon du sgrol ma nyer gcig tshar gcig nas ma chag pa 'don srol chags pa dang / sne gdong gi mi ser mang pos kyang sgrol ma skyor bar yong gi yod cing / sgrol ma nyer gcig rdzogs mtshams su phyag 'tshal ba ni zhes bton nas kha khu sim por bsdad na nyi shu rtsa gcig ces sgrol ma des gsung byon gyi yod pas sne gdong rgyal po'i btsun mo rab tu dad de sgrol mar zhal gser spus legs mthug po 'ig bsgron pas de nas bzung sgrol mas gsung ma byon sta bas mthol bshags kyi tshul du rang gis rgyan cha bshig ste gtso bo mu tig las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ sems nyid ngal gso'i 'al thang 'gran zla med pa 'ig bzhings pa da lta khra 'brug mu tig thang ga ces pa de yin/ban tshang dgon ni rtse tshogs pa'i g.yas ngos ri steng du chags yod cing dgon pa de'i thog mar phag gru'i gdan sa yin pa dang / rim bzhin bla thog bcu gsum dang / de rjes sde pa kun bzang rtse'i dgon sder gyur/dgon pa 'di'i nang rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po yod la khyad par du ya ra rje o rgyan gling pa'i sku sha skye bdun ma bzhugs pa'i gdung rten de mi bod yongs su grags pa che/sngar lo lhar sde pa gzhung gi rgyal tshab sogs kyis gdung 137

bod ljo ngas lho kha'i yu 'a tho ra gnas ljongs ngo spod — ——————————— ————— —parten de nas sku sha phran bu zhus te mi na rtsa chen bzo bi yo da cing phyi lo snga lo zhus pari sku ༅ snga ra ba'in 'khrungs kyi yod nga/ ni ches ngo mtshar ba 'ig yi na/ da lta dgon pa 'di ga'i rgya chen po rang med kyang bod kyi lo rgyus thog gnas skabs mtho po yod nga 'i dgon pa cig yin/che ring ljongs dgon/tshe ring ljongs dgon pa ni 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi shar ngos don mkhar grong gi ltag tu gnas shing / rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le2 5yod pa ngang / mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid4 1 0 0yod/dgon pa 'di kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bdun nang phyag btab/dgon pa'i mtshan cha tshang la pad ma 'od zer theg mchog gling zhes zhu ba dang / dason pa'i mtshan byung stangs ni/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa gnas der bzhugs dus phar tsa na mi tshig 'gro gi yod pa la g.yog 'khor rnams mi pha gi red dam ches bka' 'dri gnang bar mi pha gi tshe ring red ༵༵ lan zhus pas da 'o na dgon 'dir tshe ring ljongs

lngapad/ khyada'aphags bzo skrun rig dngos/zer dgos zhis gsungs pas de nas bzung tshe ring ljongs dgon zer/ sngon dpal ri dgon gyi dgon lag yin la kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'ang dpal rir bzhugs kyi yod/tshe ring ljongs dgon ni gtso bo mo dgon yin pa dang btsun ma rnams kyis snying thig phyag bzhes gnang gi yod/dgon pa 'di chags sa'i ri sul ni gtsang 'ing skyid nyams dod pa/ ri ma ldebs su shing rigs kyang mang du yod pa sogs gnas der slebs/ pa tsam gyis yid kyi dwangs ba 'dren pa cig yod cing / sngar jon ma khar grong la them dud gcig las med kyang deng char them dud kyang ma nga du 'phel yod/gong dkar chos sde dgon/gong da7ra chos sde dgon ni gong dkar rdzong khongs sgar stod grong tsho'i nye 'gram du gnas yod cing dgon pa de rngo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis rab byung brgyad pa'i shing sprel( 1464)lor phyag btab/de yang kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis gong rdzong gi rdzong dpon gnang skabs nyin 'ig thog steng du rdo rje dbyings kyi phyag dpe gzigs/ nas bzhugs pa'i tshe glo bur du rlung chen 139

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/zhig gis phyag dpe shog lhe kha shas da lta'i dgon pa chags yul gyi sa char 'khyer/ khong gis sa cha der phyag dpe sgrug par phebs skabs phyag dpe rnams bya rog gcig gis nyar tshags byas pa'am nyar nas yod pas rten 'brel 'grig par dgongs nas sa cha der dgon pa 'debs tshul zab mos rang gi yi dam la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas thugs kyi me long ngos/ sngon jo bo rje bod du phebs skabs nam mkha' nas rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'al gzigs pas phyag dang bcas ma 'ongs par gnas 'dir chos sde chen po 'ig chags par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i lung bstan lam mer 'char/ de nas gra nang dang / sne gdong / sna dkar rtse sogs kyi dad ldan sbyin bdag dang / ser skya mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor 'og dgon pa bzhings 'go btsugs pa dang / bzhengs yun dus tshod dbyar gnyis te phyi lo'i ston khar yongs su grub/dgon pa 'di'i bzo bkod la 'ang dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos shig yod pa ni gcig thog las gnyis thog rgya che ba dang / nyis thog las gsum thog rgya che ba/ de dag gi ka gdung gtong stangs sogs ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i bod rang gi shing bzo'i sgyu rtsal gzigs mor bshams pa lta bu yod/dgon pa 'di'i chos 'u gas ni sa skya yin la de'ang sa 140

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/skya'i grub mtha'i nang gses ngor gyi lugs la zer/ ngor lugs gtso bo yin pa dang gzhung dgon yin pas lo ltar lha sar tshogs chos su dge 'dun 'al grangs brgya dang drug cu lhag tsam dang / gong dkar rnga 'cham zhes pa'ang bskyon dgos kyi yod/ de bzhin dgon pa rang la'ang lo ltar smon lam skabs 'char can gos sku 'grems pa dang rnga 'cham bskyon gyi yod cing gong dkar rnga 'cham zhes pa'i sgyu rtsal ni bod yongs su grags che ba'i rnga 'cham zhig yin te/ gna' nyams dod pa dang / gar stabs 'gying che ba/ drag shul gyi nyams ldan pa/ khyad par du brdung bya'i rnga shin tu che ba de 'dra bod yongs su 'di kho na las med/sngon dgon 'dir khang tshan lnga yod pa ni/ kun bzang rtse dang / rin chen sgang / gos sku sgang / kun snang /'bras spungs bcas yin/mig sngar dgon pa 'di'i nang mkhyen bris gtsang ma'i ldebs ris ri mo'i sgyu rtsal 'gran zla med pa mjal rgyu yod pa ni dad ldan smon lam 'debs sa dang / ljongs rgyu ba gzigs mo gzigs sa ha cang legs po zhig yin/141

bod ljo ngas lho kha'i yul slor banas ljongs ngo spro da/chos sde gong dgon dang g.ya' bzang dgon/chos sde gong dgon ni rwa lo tsā bas dus rabs bcu gcig par phyag btab gnang mdzad/de yang rwa lo tsā 5 ra klung phu nas ra brgyab ste gnas gzigs la phebs slabs yar lha sham pos gangs shugs chen phab nas lam che gag pa ma zad rwa lo'i chibs rta'ang shi bas rwa lo thugs khros te 'jigs byed slom ste ma thu sngags bton pas yar lha sham ngo/'i gangs ri gsu ma cha gcig tsam bzhur stabs yar lha tham pos rwa lo'i sku mdun du gzugs brnyan bstan nas bshags pa phul te dgon pa de bzhengs rgyur sdong grogs su bya rgyu dang / phyis 'gro lam la gnod pa mi byed pa'i khas len zhus/dgon pa 'di thog mar chos lugs bka' brgyud pa yin la/ rgyal mchog lnga pa'i dus dase lugs/ par bsgyur/nge yang dgon 'angir rwa 'o 'i rnam sprul dase slong 'char ka nas bzung da lta 'i bsta na 'dzin 'u nga rtogs chos 'phags bar sku thog nyi rtsa shu bzhi byung ba dang rgyal mchog bcu gsu ma pa'i skabs ngagon pa gsar bzhengs so gas dar rgyas chen po 142

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/byung /'o ltar bod zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin gos sku chen mo 'grems srol yo da pa dus da lta'ang nyam sa med du gnas yod/da dung chos sde 'og dgon zhes pa dgun kha bzhugs sa zhig kyang yod pa ni rgyal mchog lnga pa'i skabs phyag btab gnang ba red/ g.ya' bzang dgon pa mi gangs ri yar lha sham po'i kha sprod du gnas shing dgon nge rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pas rab byung gsum pa'i me stal( 1 2 06)lor phyag btab/ khong ni srong btsan sgam po'i rnam sprul yin nga/ra grags shing dgon 'dir tshogs nyis stong brgyad brgya tsam 'dus pa sogs mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas po byung ba ma zad mthar sku 'ja' lus su phebs/bla thog sku phreng rim pa dgu byung ba dang / lhag par du rgyal ba g.ya' bzang bas bod kyi khri dpon yang gnang myong ba dang / lo rgyus thog dbang cha'i thad phan tshun 'thab rtsod thengs mang byung myong bas bod kyi lo rgyus 'ib 'jug byed dus g.ya' bzang gi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug mi byed ka med lta bur gyur gyi yo da/chos lugs kyi khyad chos thad g.ya' bzang dgon par thun mong ma yin pa'i gza' chos kyi rgyun ma nyams par lu gu 143

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/lag rgyud cig yod pas phyogs gang sa gang nas dgon pa der ched du bskyod ma/khan ha cang mang po yod/zangs chen dgon/rtsed thang nas lam spyi le15 0tsam bskyod na zangs chen dgon par slebs shing dgon pa de gnas yul ni gnyal smad grong gi ri khug tu yod pa dang dgon ming la zangs chen zhu don ni gnyal smad du 'khrungs pa'i bla ma rnam dag zangs chen zhu bas zangs chen po lung brgyad dang ldan pa zhig gter du bzhes pas zangs chen dgon zhes thogs/dgon pa 'di thog mar stod las mched pa'i chos rgyal 'od srungs kyi sku rgyud/ chos rgyal bya ba'i sras snying thig jo sras kyi phyag btab pa'i snying thig gi jo dgon zhig yod pa las rjes su dge bshes po to ba'i thugs sras dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsod nams dar rgyas kyis gdan sa mdzad par myur bar dar rgyas chen po byung ste dge 'dun zhal grangs stong las brgal zhing chos 'phel gling dang / stag tshang gling / dpal 'byor gling / rin chen gling bcas chos sde bzhi byung / de rjes gong gsal gnyal smad du 'khrungs pa'i rnam dag zangs chen zhu bas dge bshes bsod nams 'byung gnas kyi drung du 144

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/—dbu skra gtsug phud phul zhing mdo sngags gzhung lugs kun la sbyangs pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas mtshan snyan 'bar ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang por gyur/ snga phyir bla ma sku phreng bcu bdun pa byung ba dang dgon pa de'i nang rten gtso dze k+ṣim gyi dbu can thog tshad gnyis ldan dang / dgon der me skyon byung skabs ma tshig pa'i thugs dam gser sku sogs mjal rgyu yod/gzhan yang dgon de nas shar ngos su 'khor lam brgyud kyi spyi le ba'i tsam phyin na bod rgyal phran sil ma'i dus skabs kyi chos rgyal bya khri'i pho brang yang rtse'i rjes shul dang /lha khang dkar po 'es khyab 'jug gi gnas shig kyang mjal rgyu yod/yang de nas mu mthud phyin na zangs chen dgon gyi dgon lag bya yul pad ma bkong ces pa'i dgon —shul ya nga mjal rgyu yod do/ /lha lung dgon/rtsed thang nas spyi le2 2 0bskyod na lha lung dgon du slebs shing mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rngi/da4 1 2 0yo da/dgon pa de ni thog mar rgya bza' kong jos gnas 'dir kha 145

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gtad kyi lha khang 'ig chags pa shog ces thugs smon gnang ba'i bden tshig las/ shar mkhar dung gi lha khang ches gzhu spungs bzo dbyibs kyi lha khang zhig chags/ de nas bzung sangs rgyas gsung rab bdun gnas der 'phur phebs nas lha khang der bzhugs su gsol bas yul der rten chags gzhung zhes kyang zer/de rjes chos rgyal mnga' bdag khri ral gyi bre spungs dbyibs can gyi gtsang khang sbug par rgya lugs kyi dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan bzhengs gnang mdzad/ de nas rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang tshan lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgya bskyed gnang / lha lung dpal rdor 'khrungs sa'ang yul de'i byang shar gyi lha lung phu zhes par yod/lha lung dpal rdor gyis rgyal po glang dar bkrongs te mdo khams su bros byol phebs pa'i ring dgon pa de nyams chags su song /de nas phag gru'i dus rabaru/ su dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas lho brag sras mkhar dgu thog rgya bskyed gnang ba dang dus mtshungs chos lugs bka' brgyud par bsgyur/de rjes rgyal dbang lnga pa'i skabs gling bcu gsum zhes pa'i khongs su rnying dgon du bsgyur/ byang gter rdo rje brag dang / shar gter smin grol gling / nub gter rdo rje gling ste 146

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/yul rab dgon gsar/ dbus gter sangs rgyas gling ste rtsed thang ban tshang dgon/ lho gter pad ma gling pa bcas gter chen lnga las dgon pa de ni lho gter pad ma gling du grags/ pad ma gling pa'i sku skye kun bzang rang grol bar sku thog bcu gcig byung /dgon pa 'di'i nang pad ma gling pa dang / mnga' bdag nyang ral pa/ smra bo lcog gu ru chos dbang sogs kyi sku brnyan dang / nyang chos gling gsum gyi mdzad rnam 'khod pa'i ldebs ris rnying pa ngo mtshar can sogs mjal rgyu yod/da dung dgon pa de nas nub ngos su rkang thang mar chu tshod gnyis tsam song na rdzar la yag pa grong zhes pa'i yul du gu ru chos dbang si 'khrungs yul dang / gdan sa sogs kyi shul yod/dgon pa rtse dgon/rtsed thang nas lhun rtse rdzong brgyud mtsho sna'i phyogs su spyi le 18 0tsam bskyod na dgon khrod grong gi ri steng du yod pa'i dgon pa rtser slebs shing / dgon pa'i mtshan cha tshang la mtsho sna dgon pa rtse dga' ldan rab rgyas gling zhu/ dgon pa de ni thog mar mnga' bdag nyang ral bzang pos brag phug 147

bod ljo ngas lho kha'i ru 'a smor gnas rjo ngas ngo sprod/———da wa—— —————————— — —— ———— — — —————————— —da wad wa cig yo da nga/ nge'i nang lun ring sgrub pa ma dzad pa dang / de chang rem bachen ngabon pa chasas r+shang / dgon pa'i shar ngos su yo nga pa'i bla ma chu za ches nga 'i chu de'ang mnga' bdab /tang ra' ngang la bzang pos bton pa'i gter chu yin/de rjes kun mkhyen mtsho sna bas bka' gdams pa phyag bzhes mdzad pa dang / phyis rim ba'in dge ldan par gyur/de'ang kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba ni yongs su grags pa'i mkhas chen 'ig yin zhing / khong chung dus ba rdzi gnang dus nas thun min ngo mtshar can gyi mdzad 'phrul mang po 'ig yod pa dang / phyis mtsho sna lding dpon gyis gsol ba btab pa dang cha rkyen bskrun nas zangs chen pa las rab byung gi sdom pa batshes/khyad du 'phags pa'i thugs rig gi ma thus ring min sku yo na shin tu che bar gyur te dgung lo nyer gcig nas bzung〈'du'4 ba mdo rtsa'i 'grel pa legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer〉brtsam sa gnang ba bra 'or du rlung bis khyer te thim pa'i gzigs snang byung stabs ltas bzang du mkhyen nas 'jam dpal ma tshan brjod gsu nga bachen du bra 'or du phebs pas rgyal slo'i steng 'bas g.yas pa bcag pa dang dus mtshungs 'jam dpal ma tshan brjod nang gi tshig rkang gcig ste chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzugs zhes pa stabs 'khel/ de /48

lngapa/ khyada'apha༅3za mabagrodaki—/ ————— —— nas mi dkar po 'ig gis khyed 'angir phebs nga rten 'brel gyi sgo bzang po 'ig 'grig pas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i ngom du 'dir bzhugs par mdzod cig zhes zhus pa las lung bstan ltar mtsho sna khul dang / de bzhin gnas nges med du mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel/khyad par du mtsho sna ba 'di nyid du 'dul ba'i gzhung la ga'an dring mi 'jog pa'i spo bas pa thob pa 'ig yin pas gangs can mkhas/ dbang 'bum gyi spyi bor 'bas rten 'cha' ba'i rje tsong kha pas/ kyang 'dul ba 'bum sde'i mnga' bdag mtsho sna ba 'es rgya cher bsngags/dgon pa rtse'i 'du khang nang rten gtso rgyal ba byams pa thog brtseg nyis ldan sogs yod la/ da lta kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba'i spro khang nang kun mkhyen gyi bzhugs khri dang / dbu zhwa/sku ber/ rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan rnying pa'i phyag mjub sogs mjal rgyu yod /dgon pa de nas/ rkang thang du nyin gcig tsam bskyod pa'i sa na dom tshang zhes pa'i ri khrod dang / sha'u gtsug lag khang / dkar po bzang sogs dgon de'i dgon lag khag mjal rgyu yod/149

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gsang sngags chos gling dgon/rtsed thang nas yar sto da grags la dang / shor po ltag la sogs brgyab nas lam thag spyi le 2 2 0so nga ba na gsang sngags chos gling dgon du slebs shing / dgon pa de ni mtshan snyan kun tu grags pa'i 'brug pa pad ma dkar pos dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang phyag btab pa dang / de ni khong gis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa mang po'i nang gi mjug mtha' ma yin/de yang 'brug pa pad ma dkar po de/ rab byung gsum pa'i me glang ( 1 5 17) lor kong po brtse chen mdo zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs pa dang / sku tshe gang por snga phyir bod kyi sa cha ga sa gang du dgon pa mang po phyag btab/'brug pa pad ma dkar po gsang sngags chos gling khul du phebs nas sa dpyad gzigs pa na/ yul de ni gnam gru gsum/ sa gru gsum yin pa mkhyen nas sa dpyad ngan pa bzlog phyir gnas 'dir dgon cig 'debs ga' che bar dgongs nas dgon de phyag btab gnang mdzad/dgon pa 'di dang 'brug pa pad ma dkar po ni/ bod 150

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/gangs can yul tsam ma zad 'brug yul dang / la dwags/khu nu sogs kyi yul du'ang dpal lda na 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi chu 'go lta bu yin/'brug pa bka' brgyud ces pa'i mtshan ngon ni/ thog mar 'brug pa pad ma dkar po sku phreng dang po 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis grub chen gling ras pas lung bstan pa ltar chu shur gnam phur 'brug dgon pa phyag btab cing /de yang dgon pa de'i rtsig rmang 'ding dus 'brug sgra drag po thengs kha shas glo bur du grags pas dgon pa'i ming la'ang 'brug ces btags gnang ba dang / de nas bzung grub mtha' 'di'i rgyun 'dzin pa la'ang 'brug pa bka' brgyud ces thogs/'brug pa dkar po sku phreng dang po gtsang pa rgya ras nas deng bzhugs 'jigs med pad ma dbang chen bar sku thog bcu gnyis byung ba dang / sku thog ba'i pa nas bzung gsang sngags chos gling dgon du gtan bzhugs gnang /dgon pa'i 'du khang ba/ ba bcu gnyis kyi gtsang lang sbug mar bsam yas kyi jo bo byang chub chen por dpe byas te ba'engs pa'i sman 'dam gyi thub dbang sku tshad thog so gnyis ldan pad ma dkar po sku phreng ba'i pa'i phyag bzo rang byon dang / g.yas su bzhugs pa'i 'jam dbyangs/ dang / g.yon 151

bod ljo ngas lho kha'i yu la smor gnas ljongs ngo sprod /da wa —da wa——— — — —da wa— — — — — —— — —— — da da —————— da wa du bzhugs pa'i byam sa nga se+o ba ca5 kyang spru 'a sku rim/ byung gi phyag bzo 'i ra cheng / da dung kur ma gye na klong chen gyi 'bas rjes dang / mi ma yi na gyis bachengs pa'i lha mo dud so la ma 'i sku brnyan ba'i sogs sku gsu nga thugs/ rten ngo ma tshar can mang po yo/da/dgon pa de nas rkang thang du chu tshod gcig tsam phyin na ('brug pa pad ma dkar po'i gzim/ spyil zhes pa'i dgon chung 'ig yo da pa de ni/ 'brug pad ma dkar po sku phreng gnyis pas gsang sngags chos gling phyag 'angebs rgyur thugs thag bcad gnang rjes 'u nga nga/ la skuda'i phu la nga sdod sa/ 'ig brtsiḍa shig ces/ ji gas bkong gnang ba ji ba'in ba'engs pa cig yi na la/ mthar dgon nga5 chos/ dbyings su thim sa'ang de ga rang yin/ yang de nas chu tshod gsu ma tsam phyin na 'gro dgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis tsa ri'i gnas sgo phye nas phebs ska bas zhag gcig bzhugs sa 'i brag phug cig yo/da nga la thugs spro po byung stabs skyid phug ces pa'i sgrub phug dang jo dgon sgrub sde dang bcas pa ma jal yod/152

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/— ———— da wad rgya ri dbon/ma tshan cha tshang la e sto da rgya ri dgon zhes zer/ rtsed thang nas spyi le5 0tsam bskyod na dgon pa der slebs /dgon pa de ni rgyal ba ris med pas thog mar dgon de'i ltag tu yod pa'i zho'/ mo che 'es pa'i sa char dgon chung 'ig btab/ de rjes thengs shig dgon chung de nas mar gzigs nga/sa da lta'i dgon pa chags/ yu la du nyin mo du ba 'thul ba dang / ma/tshan mo me 'bar ba gzikas pas ya ma tshan skyed de slo/ba ma tshor sa cha ma gir yang snying gang cheg 'dug lto sa shig ces gsu ngas pa ltar slob ma tsho phyogs der song nas 'ib cing phra ba bltas pa na ga'an dmigs bas la gang yang med pa rtswa rgya'u zhig yo da pa mthong ba de ngon bla ma/ra zhus pas bla mas rten 'brel bzang / da nga'i dason pa sa cha der btab na bzang zhis gsu ngas nas nga lta 'i ngason pa de btab gnang ma dzang pas dason pa'i ming la 'ang rgya ri dgon zhes thogs/tho/ga ma/ra chos lugs bka' brgyung pa 'i na na'ang rjes su dge 'u gas par bsgyu ra 'ing / dge 'dun 'a' grangs bdun cu bskor zin/ dgon pa'i rten gtso 'gran med chom gsum /53

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/zhes dbus su jo bo dang / g.yas su jo bo rje/ g.yon du tsong kha pa bcas yo da/dgon pa de nas shar lho'i mtshams kyi ri ldebs su rkang thang mar chu tshod gcig tsam bskyod na e stod chu tshan zhes pa de yod/ chu tshan de ni sngar skyes bu ye shes rdo rjes 'o ma kha nas gzigs skabs e stod lung shur gyi chu'i nang chu 'gro ba 'dren pa yod pa gzigs pas e stod rong phu nas chu ded de phebs pas da lta klog ces zer ba'i grong tshor phebs skabs lung shur gnyis nas chu babs kyi yod pas chu 'gro ba 'dren pa brlags pas brlags zhes pa'i sgra nyams te phyis grong tsho'i ming la'ang klog ces zer/de nas skyes bu ye shes rdo rje khong mar log phebs skabs sku thang mnyes zhing / lhag par zhabs bsnyun te skyo mo zhes pa'i sa char sku ngal gso ba dang sbrags gsu ra btang gnang nas bzhugs skabs bya rog gcig gis gtor chas khyer song ba de'i rjes bsnyegs nas phebs pas da lta'i pho rog chu tshan 'es par pho rog de'i rkang pa bsdad yod stabs de chu tshan yin pa mkhyen nas der chu tshan bskyon pas 'bas lam seng seng drag byung ba dang / de nas bzung e stod chu tshan nam pho rog chu tshan gyi snyan grags gang sar khyab/154

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/klog chos sde dgon/mtshan cha tshang 'a klog chos sde dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling zhes zer zhing / klog grong tsho'i dbus su chags yod pas grong ming dgon par thogs nas klog chos sde dgon zhes zer/dgon pa de ni thog mar byang ngos kyi brag phug yod sar 'brug pa pad ma dkar pos btab pa'i bka' brgyud kyi dgon chung 'ig yod pa phyis lha dgra rnam gyis da lta'i dgon pa gnas yul 'dir gnas spos nas 'du khang ka ba nyi shu thog brtsegs gnyis ldan/ byams khang ka ba ba'i thog brtsegs gsum/ srung ma bsam yas dgon pa dang gcig mtshungs kyi mgon khang sogs gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas pa legs par bzhengs gnang bas rgya ri ba'i gtso dgon du gyur/dge 'dun 'al grangs lnga bcu lhag tsam gyis thos bsam slob gnyer legs par mdzad cing / rgyal ba sku phreng rim byung yang 'bas kyis bcags/ khyad par du rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos chos thebs sa 'ing dang mi ser mang po gnang 155

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo spro da/—da da ——ba dang / sla da nyams chag byung na gzhung nas gzigs skyong ma dzad rgyu'i bka' gtam gan nga ba dang thi gas chos kyi grub ma tha' kyang dge 'u gang ra par bsgyur/de rjes rgyal ba sku dri nga bdun pa bskal bzang rgya ma tshos kyang dgon pa 'dir yun ring bzhugs pa ma zad bsnyung gnas kyang gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa dang / de ba'in rgyal ba sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dang/'a/ rgya mtshos kyang dgon nga/ 'dir gzigs skyong bla na meng nga/ gnang nas dason pa 'angir bca' yig dam/ sbyar ched du gnang / dgon pa'i rten gtso sman 'dam las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa mi tshad lhag tsam gyi g.yas su rje tsong kha pa ngang / g.yon du rgya' ba bskal bzang rgya ma/tsho'i 'dra sku/ de ba'in sgro la ma lha khang nang shar li'i sgro' ma gsung byon dang bka' gdams mchod rten so gas rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten ma nga po yo da / thig phyi dgon rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le1 27tsam bskyod na thig phyi dgon par sle bas shing / mtho tshad rgya tsho'i ngos las rmid 270 0yo da/ thog ma ra dgon pa gnas sa nge mtsho yin pa dang / de nas gnas nge'i yu la gyi kha ra thod ces pas mtsho 156

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/de brtol/ de rjes mtsho mig tu klu gdol pa nag po zhes pa gdug pa can zhig gnas te skye 'gror gnod pa chen po bskyal bas de'i kha gnon du grub thob las kyi rdo rje'am lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi 'khrungs rabs nang tshan shul bu zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis mtsho gnas der dgon pa 'ig 'debs dgos thugs la 'khrungs te thig bskyon pa la mtshan mo lha 'dres phyis pas thig phyi zhis pa'i mtshan thogs/ de ltar lha 'dres ko long phrag dog byas pa'i ru gnon du phyogs ba'i dang dbus bcas par mchod rten lnga bzhengs/ de nas thig phyi gtsug lag khang bzhings/dgon pa de'i rgyab ri ni phyi glang chen gyi gzugs 'dra ba la nang bya khyung gi rang byon dang / de'i lto ba'i thad du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha khang dang / glang chen gyi mchu steng du'ang dgon pa 'ig yo/da pa de gnyis la khyung tshang zhes dang /'jigs byed lha khang la dgon pa ma thil zhes gzhi rgya shin tu che ba lta bas chog mi shis pa 'ig yod skad/gnas 'di na nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi chos 'khor shin tu rgyas pa bskor te dge 'dun yang 'al grangs chig stong lnga brgya tsam byung bami nang grags can gyi mkhas pa rje tsong kha pa dang / nam/ ma tsā 'a lhun rgyal/ nam mkha' lhun grub sogs byung / ngatshad pa'i rten 157

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gtso nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bzo sku nga 'dra ma mthong ba don grol dang / shing rtsa rin po che'i phyag bzo gu ru'i sku/nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sku gong ma'i sku sha byin can phran bu bzhugs pa'i gdung rten sogs mjal rgyu yod/spyan g.yas dgon pa/spyan g.yas dgon pa ni lho kha sa khul 'phyongs rgyas rdzong rgyas sman shang gi khongs su gnas yod cing / rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le45yod pa dang / mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid278 0yod/dgon pa de gter ston grwa pa mngon shes kyis spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis nang phyag btab/dgon pa 'di'i ming la spyan g.yas zhes zer don ni/sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i dngos slob kyi nang nas shes rab phul du byung ba shā ri'i bu'i spyan g.yas pa dgon pa de'i nang rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs yod pas dgon pa'i ming la'ang de skad ces zer/ spyan g.yas dgon pa gnas sa'i lung pa der rgyal sman zer don ni/ gna' bo'i dus su bod rgyal ga ge mo zhig (pu de gung rgyal yin zer) nad kyis mnar nas thabs shes ji 'dra zhig btang yang drag skyed ma byung bar nyen kha'i 158

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/gnas la gyar ba'i tshe/ nyams myong can gyi lug rdzi rgan po zhig gis rtswa sman zhig phul ba bzhes ma thag rgyal po'i nad gzhi seng drag byung / rtswa sman de lung pa de'i nang nas btog pa 'ig yin pas phyis lung pa'i ming la'ang rgyal po'i sman thog sa ste rgyal sman zhes yongs su grags/spyan g.yas dgon pa'i nang thugs kur spyan ras gzigs rang byon du yod pa'i li ma'i jo bo dang / rtsa che'i zhal thang rnying ma/ chos srung mgon po gri gug dang / zhang blon/ chos skyong ra mgo can gyi sku sogs yod pa ma zad/ lhag par du sku rgyu dzi k+ṣim las grub pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen zla ba'i sku brnyan rtsa chen de la ngo mtshar can gyi gtam rgyud snyan po zhig shod rgyu yod pa ste/ gna' snga mo zhig 'phyongs rgyas rgyal sman sngo thog khang gsar zhes pa'i khyim tshang de'i lug rdzi na gzhon zhig 'phyongs rgyas phu'i rtswa kha ri ma klung gi ngos su lug 'tsho bar 'gro dus dus rgyun rang gis gces par byed pa'i ra mo dkar po zhig yod pa de bar lam nyin shas ring nyin mo lug khyu'i khrod du mthong rgyu med na'ang dgong dro nang la log dus lug khyu'i nang slebs kyi yod pas kho ya mtshan skyes nas nyin 'ig ched mngags ra mo dkar po gang 'gro'i sa la 'jab blta byas pas/ ra de g.yang sa'i rtse mor gnas pa'i gna' bo'i gyang rong zhig nang 'dzul nas lha sku gsum la 159

bod ljongs lho kha'i yu la skor gams ljo ngas ngo sprod/—da —da wa 'o ma 'bul ba'im yo da nga mthong /'u ga rdzi ma thong ma thag lha sku gsu/ma pos gnam/ 'a 'phur rtsis gnang yang lug rdzis mgyogs myu ra lha sku'i 'gram du bcar nas phyag 'bu' zhus pas rngi grib phog snge 'phur ma/ thub bar mi lu la du 'u sa / 'u ga rdzis bdag gis nyes pa bsags song zhes kha 'i gnyis med kyis ba༅sas nga ngu la bas lha sku gsum gyis khyed kyis nga tshor ba༅gas pa ngabul mi dgos/ nga tsho lha yul du 'phur mi thub pa de ni 'gro don mi yul du yod pa'i rtags red/ des na khyed kyis nga cho rang rang so so gang 'dod kyis sa la skyol cil ces gsu ngas ma thag lug rdzis gus gus zhum zhum ngang khas ‘re na zhus / lha sku gcig bis nga 'phyongs rgyas ro'/ khang zhis nga ra skyel rogs gsungs pa ltar gdan 'dren zhus pa de ni ro' khang stong pa mtshan legs zhu ba'i rten gtso nge me na nga dang/ gcig gis nga yar klung lha ri zhes par skyel rogs 'es gsungs pa lta ra gdan 'dren zhus pa de ni lha ri mi na pa'i rgya pa po zhes nga 'i rten gtso de yin/yang gcig gis nga spyan ga4 /sa ches par skyel rogs 'es gsungs pa lta ra gdan 'dren zhus pa de ni spyan ga la sa rin chen zla ba ches nga 'i rten gtso de yin chos pha latam bu 'jags su gyur ro/ 160

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skru na rig dngos/da wa da da —da wa da gsang sngags gzim spyil dgon/rtsed thang grong cho'i shar gling kha pa'i ste nga gi mgon po ri ngogs su gsang snga gas gzim spyil ches pa'i btsun ma'i dason pa 'ig yo da pa de ni chu lho rgyud kyi dge 'u gas pa'i mo dgon dang po de yin/de yang gzim spyil de'i nang thog mar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos sku ma tsham sa su/ bzhugs myong bas thog ma'i mtshan gsang sngags gzim spyil zhis pa dason ming du gyur/gnas 'dir sa skya'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan bzhugs nas sa lugs phyag bzhes gnang ba dang / de rjes khams nang chen nas rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob bla ma mkhyen rab ngag dbang grags pa phebs nas dge lugs phyag bzhes gnang bas de nas/ bzung dge ru gas pa'i btsun dgon du gyur/ma dgon ni dga' lda na chos 'khor gling yin zhing /deng char 'tsho bzhugs ngag ngabang ban+ta na 'dzin tshu'/ khrims bar sma thog sku phreng brgyad byung /gas nga sngags gzim spyi' dgon gyi rten gco spyan ras 16/

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gzigs phyag stong spyan stong de ni sngon srong btsan sgam po'i skabs mgon po ri'i phyogs ba'ir spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong ba'i yod pa'i nang nas da lta bzhugs pa gcig pu de rang yin pas rig dngos dang lo rgyus kyi rin thang shin tu che/ gsang sngags gzim spyil dgon pa'i rgyab nas shar rgyag mgon po ri rtser yod pa'i spre'u brag phug la 'gro lam chung chung zhig yod/de ni spre'u brag phug la bskyod pa'i mgyogs lam yin pa dang / lam gtso bo ni mgon po rir ri bskor du bskyod dus zhor du bskyod sa yod pa de yin/gzhan yang gsang sngags gzim spyil gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su chu mig shar dang / chu mig nub ces gnyis yod pa'i chu des nad rigs mang po zhig la phan gyi yod pas deng khrus byed par yong mkhan 'tshang kha shig shig yod pa ma zad thag ring nas kyang ched mngags chu de len par yong mkhan ha cang mang po yod/162

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/bdun phud chos 'khor dgon/dgon 'di'i mtshan cha tshang la thub bstan bdun phud chos 'khor zhes zhu zhing / dgon pa 'di ni gter ston grwa pa mngon shes kyis dus rabs bcu pa'i nang gnas mang po 'ig bzhengs pa'i nang na gtso che ba bdun phud pa'i 'og gi gnas rtsa chen 'ig yin pas dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang bdun phud chos 'khor zhes thogs/phyis shel grong paṇa chen blo gros chos kyi rgyal pos dgon pa rgya bskyed dang / grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs gnang bar slob ma ha cang mang po 'dus par byams chos sde lnga yang nas yang du gsungs pas dgon de'i nub ngos su byams pa bye thang zhes pa'i ming da lta'ang mi nyams par gnas shing mtha' brgyad lcang rwa zhes pa'i ming chen po'ang dus de nas byung /chos lugs ni mtshur lugs gtsor 'dzin thog sa skya riru/ med phyag ba'es gnang gi yod la/ klong chen snying thig gi cho ga dang yang phal mo che mthun/dgon pa 'di lce bde zho‘ma grong rdal gyi dbus su chags yod cing/ lce bde zhol zhes pa'i grong ming ni yul mi rnams 163

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/lce khin tu bde bas de ltar thogs zhes zer la don dngos bo4 nas bathad na'ang skye bo pho mo tshang ma ga'an dang mi 'dra ba'i kha bde po yod/ lce bde zhol grong ni lho kha'i grong rdal che gras gnyis pa de yin la/ snam chas spyi dang / lhag par du skad grags yo da pa'i pang gdan thon yu/la 'ig yin pa ma/ zad tshong ra'ang ha cang 'khrug po yo/da pas rang ljongs tsam ma zad khyim mtshes bal po sogs kyi tshong khang ya/nga ma/nga po yo/da/grong tsho'i nub ngos su bsil dwangs chu mig ces pa yod pa ni de sngo na twa la'i bla ma rim byung gi na bza' bzo byed spus legs snam bu 'khru sa yin pas sus kyang chu bed spyod byas mi chog pa dang / sna ma bu spus legs de dag ni lce bde zho' grong rdal gyi lho ngos rnam rgyal zhol grong du 'thag gi yod/de lta bu'i 'khrug cha dod pa dang / mi rigs lag shes dang khyad chos kyis phyug pa'i grong tsho des bdun phud chos 'khor la mdzes sdug 'phar ma 'ig bsnan yod/bdun phud chos 'khor dgon pa'i nang ljongs phyi nang kun tu skad grags yod pa'i slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'i thugs dam gyi rten g.yu yi sgrol ma gsung byon 'ig yod de ni deng char kun gyi bsod nams zhing du mjal rgyu yod do/ /164

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/stod grong dgon/rtsed thang nas lho phyogs su spyi le 67la bskyod na gra nang sto da grong dgon du slebs shing / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid 270 0yod/de yang dgon pa 'di ni thog mar kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa'i 'khrungs khang yin pa dang/ phyis kun mkhyen klong chen pas dgon pa phyag btab nas khong gi gdan sa gtso bor gyur/de yang kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams ni yab slob dpon pad ma'i dngos slob rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang gdung gcig pa'i rabs las mched pa slob dpon bstan pa srung dang / yum 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gdung las mched pa 'brom bza' ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi sras su1 2 0ralor sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen dmar 'byar skabs yum gyis bu zhing kha'i wa kha'i steng ba'ag nas zhing las gnang skabs glo bur du char pa chen po babs pas gza' ma gsum gyis myur bar khyim du gdan drangs/yum gyis bu len par thad dus shul yang med pas dngangs /65

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/skra ga ngang gang sar btsal yang ma rnyed pas bshum ba'in du khyim la log dus bu la skyon ci ya nga med par khyim du yo da pa dang / bar snang nas e ka dza tis bka' bkyon yang gnang /de nas sku na cung son rjes kun mkhyen du ngos 'dzin zhus shing / bla ma skyes chen dam pa bcu phrag lnga'i 'bas 'a gtugs nas mdo sngags kyi chos thams cad dpyis phyin par mkhyen zhing / ri khrod dang brag phug sogs gnas byin can mang por sgrub pa nyams len rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ lha bla ma yi dam mang po'i 'al gzigs shing / rtogs pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa mnga' brnyes nas snyan pa'i grags pa yangs pa'i 'dzin mar lding 'ing / mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas par gyur te snga 'gyur rnying ma ba tsam ma zad yul gangs can ljongs kyi ris med grub mtha' smra ba kun gyis bcos min gyi dad pa dang / mgrin gcig gis bsngags pa'i yul du gyur/da lta dgon pa'i nang kun mkhyen klong chen dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa sogs kyi sku 'dra/ rtsa che'i ma chod rten sogs mjal rgyu yod pa dang / dgon pa'i rdo gcal dkyil du ngo mtshar byin can gyi shing bzang shug pa'i sdong po/dgon pa'i mtha' skor du rang byung shing sna mang po las grub pa'i nags tshal/ dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i ldebs su kun mkhyen klong chen gyi sgrub phub dang / sgrub chu/ de ba'in rtsa che'i dur 166

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/khrod sogs mjal rgyu yod/yar rje o rgyan gling dgon pa/rtsed thang nas spyi le'i〈bskyod na gra nang yar rje o rgyan gling dgon du slebs shing / mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid270 0yod/ dgon pa 'debs mkhan ni yar rje o rgyan gling pa yin/dgon pa'i mtshan don ni yar zhes pa stod kyi don dang rje zhes pa rje o rgyan gling pa'i gdan sa yin pas yar rje mtshan du gsol/de yang yar rje o rgyan gling pa ni1 2 2 2lor sngags rgyun khyad par can du sku 'khrungs shing / chung dus nas sman rtsis mthu sogs brtson pas sbyangs te mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob/dgung lo nyer gsum par bsam yas mchod rten dmar po nas gter gyi kha byang bzhes te shel brag gi rgyab phyogs brag pad ma/ brtsegs pa'i shel phug nas zab gter gyi ma/dzod ba'es / ga'an ya nga snga phyir gnas du ma nas gter mang po bzhis shing / bka' 'dus kyi dbang sogs gnang nas 'dul bya mang du bskyangs mthar dwags po khul du phebs 167

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/—te sku gshegs/ sku gdung dwags por spyan drangs/ phyir dwags khul sde pa 'a sa can 'ig gi sku gdung de skye bdun myong grol du grags pa shes nas gsang ba'i ngang sku sha cung zad zhus te zos pas sde pa nyam sa 'bar te sa nas khru gang tsam 'phar bas snyan grags gang sar khyab te sku gdung sne gdong ban tshang dgon du gdung rten nang bzhugs pa dang / de snga lo ltar sde pa gzhung(bod sa gnas srid gzhung) nas ched mi btang ste gdung rten dam 'byar kha phye nas sku sha lug gi mchin pa'i che chung tsam re zhus te sman rtsis khang gi sman rtsa che'i rigs la bsres sbyor byed kyi yod pa dang / zhus pa'i sku sha 'o phyi ma sngar bzhin 'khrungs pa ni mi mang pos mthong myong ba zhig yin pa dang / yar rje o rgyan gling pa'i sku sha rdul phran tsam kha la song na ngan song las thar te sangs rgyas zhing kham/sa su bde blag tu bgrod thub ces rlung ltar grags pas phyis khong gi gdan sa gra nang yar rje o rgyan gling la skye bo kun gyis dad sems dpag med zhu gi yod/mig sngar dgon pa de'i phyi brtsigs thog ma'i de de rang mi nyams par gnas yod pa dang / rgya khyon de tsam mi che yang bzo dbyibs zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo ltar mdzes shing skor lam phyi nang bar gsum yod/lhag par du yar rje o rgyan gling pa'i shangs khrag las 168

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/bzhengs pa'i gu ru pad ma sam bha ba dang / rta mgrin drag po tshar gcod kyi ldebs ris thun mong ma yin pa dang / gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs dkar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba gzungs ji snyed bzhugs pa sogs mjal rgyu yod/thang po che dgon/mtshan cha tshang la sol nag thang po che zhes zhu/ rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le2 0yod pa dang / mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid2706yod/ thog mar bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'dul 'dzin dbus gtsang mi bcu'i nang tshan lam pa klu mes pa chen po'i slob ma gru mes la sogs pa mched brgyad kyis btab/ khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis dar rgyas mdzad/kha che paṇa chen gyis rab byung bzhi pa'i me yos( 1 2 07)lor thang po cher bstan rtsis mdzad/ skabs der sangs rgyas 'das nas lo175 0song zhes gsungs/ jo bo rje'ang gnas der phebs nas 'ag bdun bzhugs kyang khu ston gyis jo bo'i 'bas la ma gtugs stabs jo bo rje nya mgo gru don nas rbod dkar la brgyud snye thang du phebs/ rjes su khu ston 'gyod pa drag po skyes nas jo bo'i rjes su bsnyegs te 169

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/zhabs la gtugs nas gdams pa mang po gsan/ phar phyin dang gshin rje'i man ngag las rtsal thon/snga phyir thang po cher skyes chen dam pa mang pos 'bas kyis bcags shing chos 'khor bskor myong bas dgon pa 'di ni byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba 'ig yin/dre'u lhas dgon dang ri thang dgon/rtsed thang nas lhun rtse brgyud spyi le157tsam song na dre'u lhas dgon par slebs shing / dgon pa de ni 'brug pa sde drug gi ya rgyal yin/ dgon pa de ni thog mar da lta'i dgon pa gnas yul gyi lho nub mtshams su ri 'bur zhig yod pa der grub pa ngag dbang nor bus phyag btab gnang ba'i 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa rdo rje gdan zhes pa gcig yo/da cing / de rjes grub dbang bstan 'dzin bzang pos lha mo dud srol ma'i rten rtsa chen dre'u 'ig la bkal nas phebs te dre'u de gang 'dra nyal yang der nga'i dgon pa 'debs kyi yin zhes gsungs/ de yang thob mar da lta'i dgon pa chags yul du bka' gdams pa'i dgon zhig yod pa la gro ba lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas zhu bas blo ldan shes rab kyi sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang dgon par nyams gso 170

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/gnang /dus phyis bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa de rim bzhin nyams nas lhas ra 'ig tu gyur yod cing / grub dbang bstan 'dzin bzang po sa cha der phebs pa dang / dre'us lhas ra de'i nang nyal bas lhas rar dgon pa btab pa dang dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang lhas dgon pa zhes gsol/ de nas grub dbang bstan 'dzin bzang po'i mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas te dge 'dun zhal grangs rim bzhin 'phel ba dang /stod la dwags rgyal po'i dbu bla'ang gnang stabs rgyal pos gser mang po phul bas dgon de'i sku 'dra'i zhal gser dang /ldebs ris sogs skye bo kun hang sangs dgos pa zhig yod/dre'u lhas dgon nas lho brgyud spyi le bcu gcig phyin na ri thang dgon rgya mtsho rin chen steng du slebs shing / dgon pa de ni gnyal sde drug gi khongs yin/dgon pa de'i lo rgyus ches ring ba ste/ thog mar gnas der gna' bo'i bon dgon 'ig yod pa la/ de rjes bka' gdams pa'i bla ma ri bo mkhyen brtse zhu bas dgon pa zhig phyag btab/ de nas rim ba'in dge ldan pa phyag bzhes mdzad/ bla ma blo bzang ri bo mkhyen brtse'i sku gdung gi phyi ngos su slar yang mchod rten 'ig dang / 'du khang ka ba so drug can sogs bzhengs/171

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/da lta lha khang ka ba rang grub can de'i nang spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong thog tshad ma dang / rigs gsu ma mgon po ngo mtshar che ba'i ldebs ris rnying ma mang po sogs mjal rgyu yod/zangs ri mkhar dmar dgon/zangs ri mkhar dmar dgon ni zangs ri rdzong gi shar ngos/ rje bzhugs grong zhes pa/ sngar rje rin po che bzhugs myong ba'i grong gi ri chung steng du gnas yod/dgon pa 'di thog mar ma gcig lab sgron gyis rab byung gnyis pa'i shing glang( 1195)lor phyag btab/de yang zangs ri zhes pa ni/ sngar yul de na zangs kyi gter kha yod par grags la deng dus kyang zangs gter dngos su yod pa dang / 'khar dmar zhes pa ni skyob ston bsod nams bla mas ma cig lab sgron la brag rdo 'ig chur bskur gnang ste 'di gang du 'khyer nas gang du bsdad kyang sa de na dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos gsungs par/ brag rdo de da yod dgon pa'i mdun gyi gtsang chu'i khrod 'khar ba dang /'khar sa ni pha bong dmar po 'ig yin pas dgon ming la'ang thog mar 'khar dmar zhes dang de nas bod yig gi go don 172

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/ltar mkhar dmar zhes zer/dgon pa de na ma gcig lab sgron gyis mo gcod kyi bstan pa ches cher spel/de yang yongs grags su nang chos thams cad rgya dkar mag sogs las dar yang / bod chos rgya gar du dar ba ni ma cig gi gcod rgyun mo gcod de kho na yin zer/des na ma cig lab sgron ni mo gcod gsar gtod pa yin pa dang / gcod dang po lho kha nas dar ba ma zad/ ma cig lab sgron 'khar dmar du ma phebs gong nas grub chen thos pa bha da dang ma/thun mjug gis sras sros gsum yang 'khrungs yod pas khong ni mi rigs gzhan dang mthun mjug gnang mkhan bod kyi rje btsun ma ang dang po de yin/dgon 'dir sngon rgya dkar nag sogs phyogs mang po nas chos zhu mkhan yong myong yod cing / thog mar mo dgon yin yang rjes su gtsang 'gram du chags pa'i dga' sgra dgon pa chus 'jig rjes gnas der spos pas pho dgon du 'gyur/dgon pa 'di ga'i khyon chen po med rung lo rgyus thog ga'an gyis tshab byed mi thub pa'i gnas bab bzung yod pas gnas skor ba dang ljongs rgyu ba tshang mas ched du yong dang yong ba'in pa yin/173

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/'ol kha chos lung dgon dang chos zam dgon/chos lung dgon pa ni sngar rje tsong kha pas 'khor dag pa rnam brgyud so so sgrub phug rer bzhugs skabs/ 'ol kha rdzong dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan thog skor du yong skabs chos lung nas 'od 'tsher ba mthong bas 'khor g.yog mngags te ci 'dug ltos shig gsungs par 'khor g.yog rnams der slebs skabs rnal 'byor pa rang rang gi sgrub phug tu bzhugs 'dug pa de don rdzong dpon la zhus pas rdzong dpon song ste rje tsong kha pa'i 'bas la gtugs nas zhabs tog sgrub rgyur khas blangs pas rje tsong kha pas nged tshor ga'an gyi rgyas spros mi dgos/ khyed kyis 'grub na 'dul ba'i spyod lam ba'i bshong ba'i khang pa zhig e 'grub ces gsungs pa rdzong dpon gyis de mar khas len zhus shing lo de rang la 'grub par byas/gnas der rje tsong kha pas 'jam dbyangs kyi lung bstan ltar sku phyag 'bum so lnga gnang bar ltung bshags lha so lnga'i zhal gzigs thob/ maṇ+ḍal rdo steng kho nar phul gnang bas phyag ngar yang brdol/ rdo'ang shel lta bur gyur/ mdo 174

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/sde phal mo che gzigs pas thugs stobs ci che 'khrungs te spyan chab kyang shor/ lhag pa'i lha dngos dang mnal lam ci rigs la 'al gzigs yang yang byung / de nas chos ra sgang zhes da lta sku rjes rang byon yod sa'i pha bong gi steng nas dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gzigs snang du byung ste dga' ldan dgon pa phyag 'debs rgyu'i dgongs tshul lham lham 'char/dgon pa 'di'i nang rje bzhi grags ma dang / ltung bshags so lnga'i ldebs ris/ rje rin po ches ma 'bul gnang sa'i rdo dang sku phyag 'bul gnang sa'i rdo/ rje rin po che dang 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad kyi phul ba'i rta rwa co gnyis ldan gcig kyang yod/ chos lung dgon pa nas cung tsam phyin na chos bsam dgon par slebs shing / de ni rje tsong kha pas tshe dpag med sgrub gnang sa yin/ gnas der rje rin po ches cha dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu btab gnang ba dang / de rjes lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang rje bsod nams blo gros gnyis kyang bzhugs myong yod/dgon de'i ltag tu lha lding ri khrod ces par rje rin po cher stong nyid lta ba 'khrungs te rten 'brel bstod pa ljags rtsom gnang sa'i gnas khyad par can 'ig yin/yo/ngas grags su 'ol kha chos lung chos zam zhes ming lhan du 'bod cing / dgon pa 'di gnyis gnas sa'i khor 175

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/yug yul ljongs mdzes sdug ldan pa dang / sa gtsang chu gtsang mkha' dbugs/ gtsang ba bcas yod pas gnas skor ba dang ljongs rgyu ba phebs sa'i mdzes ljongs khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin/bra 'or dgon/rtsed thang nas lhun rtse rdzong phyogs su spyi le1kha1tsam phyin na bra 'or dgon du slebs shing / dgon pa de ni gnyal sde drug gi gtso dgon yin/ thog mar dge bshes po to ba'i thugs sras smyos ston chos 'bar gis phyag btab pa dang mtha' ba'ir grwa shag dang lcags ris bskor bas dgon ming la grwa skor zhes zer ba sgra nyams nas bra 'or zhes 'bod/de yang sngon yul gnyal gzhung chus 'jig nas gnyal chu lung dkar po zhes zer 'ing / skabs der rgya gar nas grub chen la ba pa zhes pa bla gong la rtser phebs nas nye gnas la yul der chu ji tsam yod med ltos shig gsungs par nye gnas kyis yul der chu shin tu che bas phebs mi thub ces zhus/ dus yun cung song rjes nye gnas thengs gnyis pa yul de'i chu la blta bar gtong gnang mdzad pas nye gnas kyis da chu cung zad chung du phyin nas/ thang rgyal mtshan 'dra ba zhig 176

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/dang / gad pa glang chen 'dra ba/ de ba'in sgrub phug bcas mthong gi 'dug ces zhus par grub chen gyis da nga gnyis chu pha rir 'gro gsungs nas khyi lpags kyi bzhugs gdan ko gru'i tshul mdzad de khong bla slob gnyis gnas der phebs/ grub chen la ba pas thal mo sbyar 'ing spyan btsums nas gnas 'di ni bde mchog gi gnas khyad par can zhig yin pas byin rlabs shin tu che 'es gsungs/grub chen gnas 'dir yun ring bzhugs rjes gsang lam brgyud tsa rir phebs pa dang / mthar tsa ri la ba sbug tu gshegs/de rjes nyos ston chos 'bar dang / kun mkhyen sna ba sogs skyes chen du ma gnas 'dir byon nas chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba dang / khyad par du kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba'i gdan sa lta bur gyur nas bra 'or 'du khang rten dang brten pa bcas gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / yul de'i 'on long glen lkugs sogs skye bo mang po sdug bsngal las skyob par mdzad/deng sang yang 'du khang rnying pa'i sgo 'phyor du 'khor lo bde mchog rnam sprul la ba pa/ de yi rnam spru la gnyos ston chos 'bar dang / slar yang rnam sprul kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba/mtshungs med skyabs gnas gsum la gsol ba 'debs zhes 177

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gsal yod/dgon pa de'i nang dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ ldebs ris rnying pa mang po mjal rgyu yod cing / da dung dgon pa de nas phyin na mi ring ba'i sa la dgon de'i dgon lag o rgyan gling zhes pa'i ri khrod cig kyang mjal rgyu yod/rti'u ra dgon/rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le14 1phyin na lhun rtse rti'u ra dgon par slebs shing / dgon ming la rti'u ra zhes zhu don ni/ po to ba'i slob ma skor 'dul ba chen po'i rang gzhis chags sa'i rang ra dang nye bar chos sde btab pas rti'u ra zhes thogs shing / gnyal sde drug gi ya gyal yin/ de yang dgon pa de ni thog mar da lta'i dgon de'i nye 'dabs su rti'u ra zhes bka' brgyud pa'i dgon zhig yod pa jun gar bas rmeg med me bsregs gtong skabs rten gtso jo bo byang chub sems dpa' 'ig yod pa de mes ma 'tshig par sngar bzhin bzhugs/ de'i tshe sku gnyer gyi sems la da dgon pa mes bsregs zin pas 'dir bsdad kyang dgos pa mi 'dug snyam ste 'gro bar brtsams pa na jo bos rgyang nas gsung byon 178

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/te khyed 'gro na nga 'khrid dgos gsungs par sku gnyer gyis ngas khyed gdan 'dren zhu dgos bsam yang theg pa mi 'dug ces zhus par jo bos khyed kyis nga'i sku stod khyer na 'grig ces gsungs pa ltar sku gnyer gyis jo bo'i bka' bzhin sku smad gser las grub pa de bzhag sku stod dzhaik+ṣim las grub pa de 'khyer nas nyang dkar thang du slebs pa na sku gnyer gcin nga shor ba jo bos mkhyen nas ngas 'dir babs/ khyed gcin pa thong zhes gsungs pas sa ming la'ang babs gcin lung zhes zer/de nas sku gnyer gyis da khyed gang du phebs na legs sam zhes bka' 'dri zhus par jo bos nga gnyis shar ngos su mi ma yin gyis brtsigs pa'i mkhar zhig yod sa der 'gro gsungs nas da lta'i dgon chags yul du bzhugs/ de'i tshe dge bshes po to ba'i slob ma chag lo tsā ba yul de'i phur sgrub pa bskyon nas bzhugs yod pas gnas der jo bo'i sku stod bzhugs pa mngon shes kyis gzigs pa na nges par du dgon pa 'ig 'debs rgyu'i thugs thag bcad de las grwa 'go brtsams/ dus der rje tsong kha pa tsa ri nas yar phebs skabs chag lo tsā bas dgon pa'i rtsig rmang bting zin pas rje tsong kha pas ngas bsam pa dang khyed kyis gleng ba mnyam 'dug ces gsungs pas bsam gleng rti'u ra dgon zhes pa'i mtshan 179

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/byung / dgon pa btab grub rjes chag lo tsā bas mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs shing / thengs shig khong sgrub pa bskyon nas bzhugs skabs sde brgyad kurma nyi zlas bka' srung zhu rgyur khas blangs/dgon pa'i khor mo khor yug tu skye shing gang yang med pas nyin zhig chag lo tsā bas nye gnas la dbu skra rkang kha shas gnang ste khyed kyis skra 'di dag rgya gang che che'i sar gtor nas shing sna tshogs skye bar shog ces shing so so'i ming nas bos shig ces gsungs pa ltar nye gnas kyis dbu skra gang sar gtor zhing / shing sna 'ga' zhig gi ming bos kyang tsan dan gyi ming 'bod rgyu ma byung bar 'gyod sems chen po skyes/'on kyang yul de'i khul du shing gtan nas med kyang dgon pa'i mtha' khor shing snas khengs par dus da lta'ang tshang ma ngo mtshar dpag med skye gi yod/dgon pa'i rten gtso jo bo byang chub sems dpa'i sku stod ni dzhai k+ṣim las grub pa'i nang rten rtsa chen zhig yin pas der gsol ba smon lam ci btab na ma 'grub pa med ces so/ /180

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/gnas gzhi dgon/mtshan cha tshang la gnas gzhi zhi khro bka' brgya lha khang zhes zer/ rtsed thang nas lam thag le dbar197yod pa dang / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid28 19yo da/dgon pa de gnas ga'i grong tsho'i dbus su yod pas dgon ming la'ang gnas ga'i dgon zhes thogs/ dgon 'di thog mar gter ston 'og ma gu ru chos dbang gis phyag btab cing / yum dkar bza' mgon skyid gnyis kyi sras/ su 1 2 1 2lor bltams/ rnying ma'i gter ston brgya rtsa'i nang nas nyang nyi ma 'od zer la gter sngon gong ma dang / gu ru chos dbang 'di nyid la gter ston 'og ma zer/de yang thog mar gter ston gu ru chos dbang nyid dgon pa gnas sa'i rgyab rir sgrub pa bskyon nas bzhugs yod pa na/ glo bur du sa cha der zhi khro bka' brgyad kyi lha khang zhig bzhengs dgos thugs la 'khrungs pas nyams snang ltar dgon pa de phyag 'debs gnang mdzad/ de rjes gra phyi smin grol gling gi khongs su gyur/ thog mar dbon dgon yin pa nas rjes su gtsang dgon chags//81

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/sngon dgon pa de'i nang che mchog he ru ka sogs zhi khro'i lha tshogs cha tshang yo/da/da lta dgon pa'i bka' brgyad lha khang che mchog he ru ka dang / sgrol ma lha khang nang ston pa'i sku brnyan dang / gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ gu ru chos dbang sogs mjal rgyu yod pa dang / dgon nas nub ngos su spyi le gsum tsam phyin na mnga' bdag nyang gi gter nas brag srin po sbar rjes zhes pa'i sgrub phug cig mjal rgyu yod/shing rtsa dgon/yar 'brog shing rtsa dgon ni sna dkar rtse rdzong lhun po zhol shang khongs su gnas yod cing / dgon pa de ni 'brug pa bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma grags can 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi slob ma grags pa rin chen gyis1 198lor phyag btab pa dang / da bar lo ngo 8 07tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan/grags pa rin chen(mtshan ga'an la grags pa ras chen yang zhu) ni rje btsun mi la'i rnam sprul yin zer srol yod pa dang / dgon pa de ga'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs nang mi la'i rnam sprul grags pa rin chen la/ gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyud byin gyis rlobs zhes 'khod pa deng sang yang 182

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/tshogs gzhung du 'don mus yin la dpe rnying deng sang yang mjal rgyu yod/shing rtsa zhes pa ni dgon pa chags yul gyi ri der sa mtho'i rtsi shing spa ma mang po skyes yod pa de'i rtsa ba zhis pa'i go don tsam zhig yin zhing / dgon pa'i ming rgyas par shing rtsa thub bstan lung rtogs bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling zhes par grags/grags pa rin chen thog mar tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi srol gtod pa zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa'i dru du rab tu byung 'ing / rjes su 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi khyad chos nā ro chos drug dang / la snyoms skor drug sogs rtsa rlung gi nus rtsal la thugs yid gting nas dad de khong gi slob mar gyur pa ma zad/ sgrub pa skyon rgyu kho nar gzhol bas ras rkyang gtong ba sogs gtum mo'i bde drod kyi rtags mtshan khyad par thon par brten khong gi skabs slob ma ha cang ma nga po 'dus pa'i nang sgrub pa skyon mkhan kho na stong phrag kha shas byung bar grags shing sgrub phug ha cang mang po yod pa de dag ngeng sang yang mjal rgyu yo da/ga'an ya/nga shing rtsa dben pa'i ri khrod ces pa ltar grong sde sogs dang ma 'brel bar dgon pa kher gtsang yin pa dang / sgrub pa rgyag rgyu gtsor bzung thog de snga ras rkyang 183

bod ljo ngas lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/gtong ba zhes rtsa rlung sbyong ba dang / gtum mo'i bde drod kyi sbyong brdar tshad gzhi dngos 'brel ji tsam 'ig tu slebs yod med rgyugs len 'gran bsdur byed srol dang / grwa btsun rnams la shing rtsa'i sgrub pa ba bzhes sbu skra ras lcog rgyag srol yod/ deng rabs spyi tshogs yar thon gyi 'phrod bsten blang bya dang mtshams phyir sgom sgrub nyams len sogs kyi thad sngar srol rgyun 'dzin gang thub byed bzhin pa las dbu skra ras stog rgyag gi med/grags pa rin chen nas da lta'i shing rtsa'i sprul ming 'dzin po bstan 'dzin chog grags(chos ming dngos kurma ye she rgya mtsho) bar bla rabs bcu ba'i byung / dgon pa de ni phag gru'i srid dbang sogs kyi skabs dar rgyas chen po 'dug kyang bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang dge lugs pas bzung rjes rim ba'in nyams rgud du gyur cing dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gong dge 'dun zhal grangs 2 0tsam dang / shing rtsa'i dgon lag yar 'brog skar ma gling rtswa thang gi byang ngos ri bo'i thog la wa dgon zhes pa der btsun ma 'al grangs 2 5tsam yo da/dgon pa chags yul gyi ri bo de glang chen 'gying ba lta bu'i brjid nyams zhing mdun ngos na yangs shing rgya che ba'i rtswa thang thog rtsa che'i srog chags rkyang dang dgo ba sogs ri dwags 184

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/kyi khyu tshogs dang / sgo phyugs 'bri g.yag dang ra lug rta sogs phan tshun 'cham mthun mnyam gnas kyis rang byung rtswa thang gi mdzes ljongs thog rtsi bcud sna tshogs kyi dpal la rol ba'in du mchis/ lho ngos kyi gangs ri ni bka' brgyud chos lugs pa'i cho ga dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi rtsa gsum mchod pa'i ( gtor ma) dbyibs ji ma ji bzhin du yod cing /gnas 'dir zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las ji 'dra bsgrubs kyang 'grub bde bar grags/deng sang 'di khul du dgon pas 'gan 'khur dang bas blangs te srog chags srung skyob dang / skye khams khor yug srung skyong gang thub kyis ma 'ongs par sa mtho'i khyad chos ldan pa'i ljongs rgyu'i gnas mchog cig tu 'gyur rgyur 'bad brtson byed bzhin du yod/dgon pa gnas yul du mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre45 0 0yas mas yod pa dang / rtsed thang nas dgon pa bar lam thag spyi le175 sna dkar rtse rdzong nas dgon par spyi le17rnga mtsho smad nas spyi le kha8bcas yod/185

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/brag ra dgon/rtsed thang nas sna dkar rtse rjong phyogs su spyi le 179tsam bskyod na brag nor med ra dgon du slebs shing /dgon pa'i mtshan cha tshang la brag ra bsam gtan chos gling dgon zhes zhu/dgon pa de ni thog mar brag ra sku phreng dang po ka sas phyag btab cing / de yang brag ra sku phreng dang po ni/ dgon pa de dang nye ba'i skyes sdong zhes pa'i sa char 'khrungs/ chung dus khyim la ra gcig yod pa de'i ra rdzi gnang zhing / de nas ra de phu ma g.yu mtsho'i rgyab kyi grong zhig la bcol gnang bas yu la der da lta'ang ra bcol zer ba dang / rim ba'in ra de gzugs stobs che ba rkyang lta bu zhig chags pas yul der ra rkyang zhes kyang zer/de rjes khong gis ra de tshur skong nas lam du ded bzhin du ra khyod gang du bsdad kyang nga de gar sdod kyi yin 'es gsungs pas ra des da lta'i dgon pa chags yul du nyal nas ma langs stabs khong gis de gar dgon pa btab pa dang /dgon pa'i mi la'ang brag ra dgon zhes gsol/ jun gar 186

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/ba'i dmag de gar yong dus khong gis sku gzan nyi zer la bkal ba sogs rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan nas bkag pas dgon pa ma gtor ba ma zad/ sdig bshags tu dgon pa'i mtha' bskor la lcang ma'ang mang po btsugs/phyis sku phreng bzhi pa kun bzang pad ma 'gro 'dul rdo rje brag gi mkhan po gnang rjes chos lugs bka' brgyud nas snying thig tu bsgyur gnang mdzad/ khong gis shel brag nas mchod rten dang sku bcu gnyis gter nas bzhes pa dgon pa'i nang rten du bzhugs/ brag ra sku phreng dang po raṇ+ḍa nas da lta 'tsho bzhugs rnam grol mdo sngags bstan 'dzin rdo rje bar sku thog drug byung /da lta dgon par ston pa'i sku thog brtsegs nyis ldan dang / gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs kyi sku brnyan mjal rgyu yod/da dung dgon pa de'i ri rgyab tu brag ra me gling zhes pa'i jo dgon gyi rjes shul yang mjal rgyu yod/dga' tshal sbyag dgon/de yang rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi lo65tsam bskyod na gra nang rdzong khongs rgyal gling tshogs pa dgon du slebs shing /rgyal gling tshogs pa dgon ni kha che paṇa chen gyi dngos slob 187

bod ljongs lho kha'i yu la skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/mkhan chen byang chub dpal bas rab byung ba'i pa'i shing sbrel( 1 2 2 4)'o ra phyag btab pa'i tshogs pa sde ba'i'i ya gyal 'ig yin pa dang / rgyal gling tshogs pa dgon nas shar ngos su spyi le 2tsam phyin na dga' tshal sbug dgon du slebs/de yang dga' tshal sbug dgon ni rgyal gling tshogs pa'i dgon bdag rgyal tshogs dpa' bo rin po che sku phreng rim byung gi bzhugs gnas yin pa ma zad de gar rgyal gling tshogs pa dgon gyi dge 'dun bgres gras bsnyen sgrub gnang sa dang /rig pa bkra ba'i dge 'dun gzhon gras gzhung chen la sbyangs pa gnang sa 'ig yin pas snyan grags gang sar khyab nas sngar de gar rang dgon tsam ma zad lha sa khul dang / gtsang khul/mdo smad/ 'brug yul sogs nas kyang gzhung chen la sbyangs pa gnang mkhan mang po phebs kyi yod/dga' tshal sbug dgon pa'i nang o rgyan rin po che snang srid zil gnon srid na dkon pa'i byin rten ji snyed gzungs su bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon du kun mkhyen klong chen dang /kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling / thub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal tshogs dpa' bo sku gong ma'i 'dra sku sogs dang / de ba'in rnam sras 'ja' rnying ma la sogs pa'i 'al thang ches rnying ma mang po dang / sku tshad gter lnga'i ya gyal zhig sogs byin rlabs shin tu che ba'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po zhig ma jal 188

lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/rgyu yod la khyad par du paṇa chen rdza sku rin po che mjal rgyu yod pa de ni dgon pa'i rten gtso yin 'ing / thog mar tshogs pa sde bzhir re re yod kyang da lta ngo ma bzhugs pa ni 'di rang las med/da dung par+ṇa checha rdza sku rin po che rang byon ji ltar phebs tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar can 'ig yod pa ste/sngar paṇa chen gyi 'al slo ba rdza mkhan 'ig yod pa de par+ṇa chen rin po che'i drung du bka' chos zhu bar 'gro dus nub ngos su bskyod dgos pas ltag khung la nyi ma shar ba dang /dgong dro shar ngos su log dus kyang lta ga khung la nyi ma shar gyi yod pas ming la'ang rdza mkhan ltag pa nyi shar zhes zer/par+ṇa chen dgongs pa rdzogs rjes rdza mkhan gyis dad sems dpag med dang / blo pham dpag med ngang par+ṇa chen gyi 'dra sku kha shas bzhengs dgos snyam nas bzhugs khri bzo thub kyang 'dra sku bzhengs ma thub pas bzhugs khri re re'i steng 'dam bag dog rdog re re ba'ag nas de nub gnyid du yur ba na/phyi nyin zhogs pa ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i 'dra sku rang byon phebs pas rab tu dga' 'ing paṇa chen rin po cher rab tu dad pa gyur/ de lta bu'i byin rlabs tshan kha 'bar ba'i par+ṇa chen rdza sku rin po che ched du mjal bar phebs mkhan thag ring thung ga sa ga nas ha cang mang po yod/189

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/da dung dga' tshal sbug dgon ni grong dang ma 'dres pa'i ri sul gyi mdzes ljongs nang gnas yod la/ rtswa chu 'dzom sa shing / 'bras lda na ljon pas bskor ba'i dben pa'i gnas nyams dga' ba 'ig yod pas chos gsha' ma bya sa'i gnas mchog rang yin no/ /

drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khrud chos gzigs 'dod na/ sku nyid bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho khad phebs/yar klung khul gyi rlung dar 'dzugs srol skor/de yang ljongs rgyu ba zhig bod du slebs skabs thog mar thag ring nas mthong ba'i mngon gsal dod shos kyi dngos po zhig yod pa ni dar lcog ces pa de lags/ dar lcog ces pa'i tshig de la thog mar chos lugs kyi nang don med cing bon ston gshen rab mi bo che'i dus su zhang zhung yul du lug bal dang g.yag gi rtsid pa rgyug pa'i rtser btags nas 'dzugs srol dar ba dang de'i don snying ni thog mar mdzes rgyan lta bu nas rim bzhin rlung rta 'phel ba'i nang don ldan pa zhig tu gyur/ de rjes g.yul du sku srog shor ba'i dpa' bo'i bang so'am sa phung steng 'dzugs kyi yod pa de ni dpa' nyams mtshon pa dang / dran gso zhu ba'i ched du yin pas gong gsal nang don tha dad yin/191

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su bon gyi chos lugs dang goms sro'/ 'ga' 'ig ya ra klung khul du dar ba dang chabs cig bal rtsid kyi dar lcog(de la yar bskyed zer)dar sro la yang ma nyam du dar/ de mi bod du dar lcog 'dzugs srol thog mar dar ba 'ig yin pas rim ba'in tshang mas de la lad mo byas nas bod yo/ngas su dar lcog 'dzugs srol sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur/ dar lcog ces pa de yang kha skad yin pas yig thog phal mo cher rlung dar zhes brjod/ de'i skor ngo sprod rags tsam zhu na/1 rlung dar ni bon gyi grub ga'i sa chu me rlung mtshon pa 'ig yin te/ g.yu nga drung bon gyi lugs su phyi snod kyi 'jig rten chags tshul 'byung bar ba'i las grub par smra la/nang bcud lus khams kyi grub tshul yang 'byung ba bzhi las rgyas bshad byed pa yin pas 'byung ba'i khams rnyogs pa ni bde skyid kyi rtsa ba 'ig yi na bsam nas rlung dar 'dzugs pa dang de ba'in lha gsol dang klu gsol/ btsan gsol sogs kyi cho ga la 'ang 'byung bache snyoms sgrig gi lta ba de 'khyer nas 'grel bshad byed kyi yod/2 bod rgyal dang po gnya' khri btsan po'i dus thog mar yar klung khul du bal rtsid kyi rlung dar 'dzugs srol dar ba nas rim ba'in ras snam gyi rlung dar 'dzugs srol la 192

drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad chos bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho kha/'gyur ldo ga byung yod kyang dus yun ring po zhig nang rlung dar gyi tshos mdog mi 'dra ba yod pa las/ rlung dar ngos su ri mo dang yi ge med/2 phyis rlung dar ngos su ri mo stag se nga khyung 'brug 'bri ba de'ang bon gyi gsar gtod byas pa'i 'byung bzhi mtshon byed yin te/ sa yi mtshon rtags seng ge dang / chu yi mtshon rtags 'brug me yi mtshon rtags khyung / rlung gi mtshon rtags stag yin 'ing / dbus kyi rlung rta'i mtshon ris gtso bo sgal steng du yid ba'in nor bu bkal ba'i rta de ni phyis su sangs rgyas chos lugs pas bsnan pa zhig yin/ de'i go don ni/ rta mchog de rin chen bdun gyi gras shig yin tshul sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dpe cha'i nang 'khod yod pa ma zad rta yi sgal steng du nor bu gsum bkal yo/da pa'i dpe ris de'ang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi shod srol dang yongs su mthun pa 'ig yin no/ /4 stag seng khyung 'brug ni lha sgrung nang gsal ba'i srog chags yin pas khyung ni rtsal dang / 'brus ni grags pa/stag ni dpa' nyams/ seng ge ni shugs kyi mtshon byed yin zhes 'grel bshad rgyag srol yod/ da dung srog chags ba'i po rim ba'in/ sro/ga dang / lung / dbang thang / rlung rta bcas yin pa'i shod srol chig kyang yo/da//93

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/5 bar skabs kyi dus skabs nang rlung dar gyi ri mo'i nang g.yag 'bri srol 'ig byung 'dug kyang de dar khyab tu ma/ phyin par dus thung nang med par gyur 'dug6 deng char rlung dar ni sangs rgyas chos lugs pas bsod nams dang / bde skyid/ dbang thang sogs mtshon pa'ang rlung rta dar ba'i ched du bsngo smon byed pa 'ig la 'gyur yod kyang thog ma'i 'byang khungs ni bon rang yin rtserno/ / ra yar klung khul gyi gna' bo'i dur mchod byed stangs/yar klung ni bod mi rigs kyi 'byung khungs dang / rig gnas dang lo rgyus kyi chu 'go yin pa ma zad pur rgyal bod kyi btsan po rim byung gi bzhugs gnas yin la bod kyi btsan po'i bang so'ang mang che ba yar klung khul du yod pas yar klung gi gna' bo'i dur mchod byed srol ni bod kyi 'o rgyus hril po dang 'brel ba ha cang chen po yod/de yang yar klung lo rgyus thog snga phyir dur mchod byed stangs mi 'dra ba bzhi byung ba ste/1 phur bya rgod la gtor ba'i dur mchod dang /194

drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad chos bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho kha/2 4ra sa 'og la sba ba'i dur mchod/2 phur chu la bshams pa'i dur mchod/4 bur me la bsregs pa'i dur mchod bcas so/ /dang po/ pur bya rgod la gtor ba'i dur mchod/bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po'i dus nas dar bar te/ gnya' khri btsan po dang / mu khri btsan po/ ding khri btsan po/ so khri btsan po/ mer khri btsan po/ gdags khri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po bcas la gnam gyi khri bdun zer ba dang / sku gdung 'ja' ltar yal/ bang so mkha' la btab ces pa so gas ni che bkod byas pa tsam yin pa las don dngos su gnam gyi khri bdun po'i sku gdung ri mtho sa gtsang 'ig tu 'khyer nas bya rgod la longs spyod byed du 'jug pa dang / pur nam mkhar lha yis spyan drangs zhes bon gyi 'dod tshul dang mthun par brjod/ srol rgyun 'dir deng sang yang phung po bya gtor zhes bod kyi sa phyogs gar sar khyab/195

bod ljo ngas lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo spro da/gnyis pa/ pur sa 'og tu sba ba'i dur ma chod/bod kyi rgyal rabs brgyad pa gri gum btsan po'i dus dar ba ste/ de yang gri gum btsan po lo ngam gyis bkrongs nas rgyal srid 'phrog sras sha khri dang / nya khri kong po'i yul du bskrad/ dus phyis sra sa nya khris chu srin bye ma lag ring bi sa nas yab kyi sku gdung blus shing / ( ru las skyes kyis rabs sna tshogs kyis myang chu skya mo nas gri gum gyi pur btsal zhes kyang zer ) skabs der lo ngam 'khor dang bcas pa da dung brlag med pas dgra bo de dag gis yab kyi sku gdung shes na gnod par dogs te phying ba stag rtse'i khor yug gi sa btsan sa zhig tu yab kyi bang so brtsigs pa de nas bzung pur sa 'og tu sba ba'i srol thog mar byung /de rjes rim byung btsan po mi nyung ba 'ig gi bang so rdza ri mtho 'ing btsan pa'i gnas su brtsigs shing / bang so'i dbyibs zlum po yin/ de nas rim ba'in btsan po'i bang so ri la brtsigs pa de thang ngam yul du brtsigs pa'i srol dar/gnam ri srong btsan dus nas pur khang ba'engs pa'i srol dar zhing / pur khang ni rgya che 'ing / thog rtsegs ldan pa 196

drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad chos bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho kha/ba'engs pa ste〈bang so'i dkar chag〉la sa srong btsan gyi bang so 'phying phur btab/ phyi dbyibs gru ba'i/ nang du re'u mig dag lha khang lnga/ dbus su ring tshad khre tse bco brgyad yod pa'i byu ru'i sdong po rgyun bkang gi ma/tshon byed du byas/zur bzhi'i mchod khang rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang /nang skya rdo leb gru ba'i ma kun nas bsgrigs/ phyi skya gyang sa mthug po bslangs/ bang so 'i sgo mo nub 'a gtad/ bang so 'i phyir sa smug po dang rdo hrug gis bkab nas rde'u 'bur 'ig tu gyur/ mu mtha' so so ra zheng tshad gom pa brgya lhag tsam dang mtho tshad la gzhu 'dom bcu gnyis tsam yod/ bang so'i steng du lha khang chung ngu bzhengs yod ces gsal ba ltar yin 'a / pur sgam gyi rtse mo nges par du nub phyogs su gtad dgos don ni/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ pa ma tshon no/ / srol 'di nyams nas da lta rna thos tsam du gyur/ 'on kyang lho pa bas deng yang pur sa 'og tu sbas kyi yod zer/gsum pa/ pur chu la bshams pa'i dur mchod/pur chu la bsham sa pa'am bskyur ba'i ni bod kyi rgyal rabs bcu drug nga/ za nam zin lde'i dus/ nas dar cing de 197

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/yang nam zin lde dang / le 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ se snol gnam lde/ lde snol nam/ lde snol po/ lde rgya' po/ lde sprin btsan bcas la lde brgyad zer 'ing / pha dag gi bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab ces zer don ni pha dus btsan po'i pur rin po che'i gos rgyan sna tshogs kyis yongs su btums pa dang / gser dngul g.yu byur sogs dang mnyam du dngul lam zangs sgam kha sprod ma 'i nang du bcug nas chu bor bskyur te/ btsan po'i pur de sa ga'i skyong ba'i lha dang / mtsho nang gi nor bdag klu rnams dgyes pa'i skyes su mchod pas lung par phyugs zog 'phel zhing lo legs yong ba mtshon pa yin zer/ pur chu la bskyur ba'i srol de thog mar byung ba nas dus da lta'i bar ma nub par gnas/bzhi pa/ pur me la bsregs pa'i dur mchod/pur me la bsregs pa'i dur mchod ni gna' dus su byung bar mngon zhing / dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi 'i byed pa'i chos lugs bod du dar zhing khyab pa'i rjes su mi tshe las 'das rjes phung po mer bsregs pa'i srol de ches cher dar ba dang / srol de la yongs grags su bzhu bsregs zer ba dang / 'ga' res 'e 198

drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad chos bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho kha/tshig spyad de bzhugs 'bul zhes zer ba deng char ngag gtam 'a gyur/de yang bla ma dang dpon chen gshegs na bzhugs bsreg gam bzhu 'bul byed pa las spyir btang gi mi phal pa shi na bzhu bsregs mi bya/ la las rang gi drin can pha ma gshegs na bzhu bsreg byed mkhan yod kyang de ni grangs tshad ha cang nyung nyung yin pas/ bzhu bsregs gam bzhugs 'bul ni dur ma chod byed stangs nang nas khyad du 'phags pa'am mchog tu gyur ba 'ig yin/ srol 'di'ang dar ba nas bzung da lta bar mi nyams par gnas yod/btsan po gnam gyi khri bdun skabs kyi chos lugs skor/bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther khag nang btsan po khri bdun gyi skabs rgyal sring sgrung dang lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs zhes yo ngas grags su 'khod yod pas/ gong gsal btsan po'i bzhugs yul yar klung kho na yin stabs 'dir de dus kyi chos 'u gas skor ngo sprod ma dor bsdus zhu rgyu yin/199

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/—gcig btsan po dang sku bon gyi skor/btsan po dang sku bon ni 'brel ba ha cang zab pa cig ste/ btsan po ni dbang cha che shos kyi rgyal po yin pa dang /sku bon la brten nas btsan po'i snyan grags bod khams yongs su khyab yod pas sku bon ni bod rgyal gnya' khri'i skabs su thog mar byung ba dang / rim bzhin rgyud 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas su phyin yod pa ni bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther las de'i sras ding khri btsan po zhang zhung gi gshen bon kun 'dus theg chen gyi sku bsrungs song / de'i sras mu khri btsan po/ bon po gshen po tshe rgyal gyis sku bsrungs song / de sra/sa sribs khri btsan po/ 'ang zhung gshen po kun ring rgyal pos sku bsrungs song / de'i sras ye shes khri po/ bon po g.yung drung rgyal pos sku bsrungs song / de'i sras gnya' khri po/mon po kun rtogs rgyal pos sku bsrungs song / de'i sras sribs khri po/ bon po 'ang zhung lha 'od kyis sku bsrungs song /de'i sras sribs po/ bon po 'ang zhung lha 'od kyis sku bsrungs so zhis gsal bas btsan po'i mtshan 'bod tshu' cung mi 'dra ba las don dngos thog gnya' khri phud pa'i gnam 200

drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad chos bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho kha/gyi khri drug po la zer/ sku bsrungs so ches pa'i don la dpyad na/ sku bon rgyun du btsan po dang mnyam sdod byed dgos pa ma zad/ btsan po'i sku srog kyang sku bon gyi lag tu bzung yo/da pa shes thub/ der ma sku bon byung ba ni bod gna' rabs kyi spyi tshogs nang lus kyi ngal rtsol pa dang / bsam pa'i ngal rtsol pa gnyis so sor kha gyes pa'i mtshon rtags yin pa dang / sku bon ni bsam pa'i ngal rtsol pa ste/ shes pa can du brtsi chog de dus bod kyi mi rnams kyis 'jig rten khams kyi sems can dang / dngos po yod do la lha 'dre zhugs yod par ngos 'dzin byed cing / 'dod tshul de la brten nas lha dang / btsan/ gnyan/ klu bcas tshad mtho ba'i rigs du ma gas ra skrun byas te de dag ni tshe ring zhing nus mthu khyad du 'phags pa/ gnam 'og tu 'gran zla med pa'i dpung mgon la brtsis nas nam yang gzab nan gyis cho ga bkur ste mchod pa rgya cher sgrub na/ da gzod mi'i spyi tshogs la bde 'jags dang bde skyid yong nges yin snyam zhing cho ga gal che de dag sgrub rgyu dang / btsan po'i sku srog dang dbang thang srung skyob/de bzhin btsan po'i dur 'jug bya rgyu bcas ni sku bon gyi las 'gan gtso bo yin/201

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod /gnyis/ sgrung dang lde'u'i sko ra/sgrung dang lde'u ni bon gyi gong nas byung zhing / der sa gnas dang dmangs khrod kyi rang ba'in shugs cher lnga na yod/'on kyang thog mar sgrung dang lde'u la lha yi chos lugs zhis chab srid skyong ba'i gnad dam par brtsis yod pa ni bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther las lha yi chos lugs sgrung dang lde'u byung zhes gsal 'ing /de yang skabs de'i sgrung ni lha sgrung gi khongs su gtogs pa dper na/ ma sangs kyi sgrung zhes pa'i nang ma sa ngas ni bod rigs kyi mes por gyur ba'i gna' bo'i gdung rgyud gcig yin pa'i lha sgrung bshad yod/ de ba'in lde'u zhes pa de'ang deng sang ltar na blo rig 'gran pa'i rig pa zhig yin na'ang de dus sgrung dang 'dra bar lde'u'i nang don gtso bo rang gi mes po dang / 'byung khams chags tshul/ skye rga na 'chi sogs tshang mar lha 'dre zhugs su bcug nas ngo ma tshar sgro btags kyis nyan pa po rnams yid ches dang dad mos skye ru bcug nas srid la 'bas 'degs zhu gi yo da pas chab srid sgrung dang lde'u bon gyis bskyangs zhes bsgrags so / /202

drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad chos bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho kha/lhad med bza' bca'/ yar klung gsol zhib/yar klung gsol 'ib/ yar klung ljags smin/ yar klung rtsam pa/'dzam gling yang rtse'i zas mchogagangs ri'i ljongs kyi sman bzang /nam mkha' g.yu lta ra sngo ba'i 'og gi pha yul/sprin pa dung ltar dkar ba'i 'og gi grong tsho/mkha' rlung shel ltar gtsang ba'i khrod kyi 'ing thang /gangs chu dri med bdud rtsis bskyangs pa'i ljang pa/mtho tshad spyi khre bzhi stong yan gyi me toga'adzam bu'i gling la gcig kho na las med pa'i thun min khyad ldan gyi stabs bde'i zas rigs/dkar mo nas kyi nying khu/ gangs ltar dkar ba'i gso la cheb/ 'di ni 'ing gi mes po sbar ras zhing gi tsha bo red/'ari mi ya ra lha sham chu'i nu zhos gsos pa'i khye'u red/'di mi yar klung 'bru mdzod chen po'i rtags ma red/'das pa'i 'o rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang /203

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/las la brtson zhing shes rig ldan pa'i sa mtho'i bu phrug rnams kyis yum bu brla mkhar dang po ta la so gas bskrun myong la/ dpa' ngar chen pos rang srung dbyin 'gos dmag 'khrug byed myong / da dung 'dzam gling kun la snyan pa 'brug ltar ldir ba'i/ 'od stong 'bar ba'i gangs ljongs rig gnas kyang gsar gtod byed myong /yar klung gsol zhib/ yar klung ljags smin/ yar klung rtsam pa/khyed kyis yar klung gsol 'ib ljags bro( bro bka 'ig gzigs dang / pho bar bde zhing zas kyi dwang ga bye ba/ rgas par dka' 'ing mdzes nyams thon pa/ lus stobs nyin nas nyin bzhin rgyas te/ khyed sa mtho'i lha g.yag lta bur 'gyur nges yin/khyed kyi yar klung gsol zhib rgyun du mchod dang / don lnga snod drug kun la phan zhing / khyad par du gcin pa mngar skyur gyi nad dang / mchin mkhris nad rigs ma lus 'joms pa dang / khyed tshe ring lo brgya thub par gdon rmi za/mig sngar tshan rig lag rtsal 'bar gas rab tu che 'ing /slob gso 'phron bsten gyi bstan pa ches cher dar bas/ yar klung gsol zhib la lang tsho'i me tog gsar pa ba'ad de/tshan rig gi las snon 'bras bu g.yur du za ba smin/204

drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad chos bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho kha/gzigs dang /bltas na dkar zhing mdzes par yar klung gsol zhib/mchod na zhim 'ing bcud ldan yar klung gsol zhib/btsongs na brin zhing gong bzang yar klung gsol zhib/khyed ni lhag bsam mtshon pa'i gangs dkar yin pas/khyed kyis sku mgron rnam pa'i thugs 'dod skong ba'in yod la/khyed ni bkra shis mtshon pa'i mjal dar yin pas/khyed kyis sku mgron rnams phebs bsu zhu ba'in yod/lhad med bza' bca'/ zhol gsar 'bri mar/'dzam gling yang rtse'i steng gi/ rnam shes yod pa'i nor bu 'bri g.yag gi khyu tshogs/ lus stobs glang chen ltar che ba/brjid nyams seng ge ltar dod pa/ grang ngar la mi zhed cing /ngal las la'ang mi skrag gnya' yis zhing rmod thub la/ sgal par rdog khres 'khur thub/ da dung / gdan 'bol lta bu'i sgal steng du bzhon nas/ lam yod med la mi ltos par/ ri klung kun tu yul skor spro 'cham la bskyod chog tha na khyed kyi lce ba'ang / me la 'bud chog la zhing lud kyang byas chogade ltar/ khyed kyis tshe gang mgo nag mi la 'bas 205

bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/'degs zhus te sku tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs na'ang / sha khrag longs spyod byas chog la/ pags rigs gos su bklubs chog cing / spu rtsid kyis nyal chas kyang btags chog tha ngan rus pas kyang thang bskol chog pa/ rwa nyer mkho'i dngos rdzas bzos chog pa ma zad/ sa mtho'i khyad chos ldan pa'i mdzes rgyan du'ang ngoms chogakhyad par du 'bri bzang gi nu ma las 'bab pa'i mngar zhim gyi 'o ma sos pa/ bzho gyin bzho gyin zhal du mchod chog la/ 'bri bzang gi 'o mas bsrubs pa'i nying bcud zhol gsar 'bri mar snyags bag gsol ja bsrubs ma/ zhim mngar thud kyi rdar tshan/ bcud ldan mar spags snum 'tshir/ser hrog bag rtsa mar khu/ lhad med bza' bca'/ zhol gsar 'bri mar/ lus stobs gso ba'i zas mchog nad rigs 'joms pa'i sman mchog khyad par du/ rlung nad la mchog tu gyur pas/ nyin mo sems bde zhing / mtshan mo gnyid skyid pa/ nga tshos 'bri mar gyi gsol ja 'khyer nas phebs sgug zhu bzhin yod pas/ sku mgron lhan rgyas lho khar phebs dang / gsol ja bsrubs ma mchod par phebs dang / / / /206

sbo kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/rtsom sgrig pa/ ma5bas grub/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ rkang btsugs/mdun shog 'chan 'god pa/ skal tshe/ban bcug par ris 'char 'god pa/ skal nor/glog klad par gzhi sgrig mkhan/ bde chen/ ngape mar 'grems spel tshar pa/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang // spu (lha sa gling skor byang lam sgo yang 20)par 'debs tshan pa/ si khron rang byung khams par 'debs tshad yod kung si/deb tshad/ 787nga960 1732par shog 7skyo/bka sbyo/ngabasko / khri 9ban bcug par ris/ 80pan gzhi/ 2009lo'i zla 4par par gzhi 1bsgrigs/par thengs/ 2009lo'i zla 4nga ra par thengs 1btab/par grangs / 01 —4’000dpe debayangartags/ 138sa978 —7 —223 —02625 — 3rin gong sgor/ 20 00par gzhi sger bdag yin pas 'dra bcos par 'debs mi chog
